# chadcn: full reference

> Phlex components that port shadcn/ui 1:1 (same names, same Tailwind classes, same data-slot markup) with Stimulus behavior (`chadcn--*` controllers). Compound components nest their parts (`Dialog::Content`) and also yield a root with one helper per part.

chadcn is a Ruby gem (RubyGems only). Not affiliated with shadcn. Built on shadcn/ui (MIT).

Setup: [README](https://github.com/doncan-orozco/chadcn/blob/main/README.md). Generated by `rake llms:generate`. 58 components. Namespace: `Chadcn`. Render with `render Chadcn::Button.new(...) { ... }`.
Every component accepts extra keywords as HTML attributes (`class:` is merged with Tailwind conflict resolution, `data:` and `aria:` are deep-merged).

<a id="component-accordion"></a>
## Accordion

shadcn Accordion over Radix Accordion.

Constructor: `Chadcn::Accordion.new(type: "single", value: nil, default_value: nil, collapsible: false, disabled: false, dir: nil, orientation: "vertical", as_child: false, id: nil, **attrs)`

- `type` [String, Symbol] `"single"` or `"multiple"` (anything else is `"single"`)
- `value` [String, Array<String>, nil] open item value(s); non-nil makes the accordion controlled
- `default_value` [String, Array<String>, nil] initially open item value(s) when uncontrolled
- `collapsible` [Boolean] whether the open item of a `"single"` accordion can be closed (always true for `"multiple"`)
- `disabled` [Boolean] disables every item
- `dir` [String, Symbol, nil] reading direction (`"ltr"`/`"rtl"`); falls back to the Direction provider
- `orientation` [String, Symbol] `"vertical"` or `"horizontal"`
- `as_child` [false, nil, Symbol, String, Chadcn::Base] a tag name (`:a`) or a component to render instead of the default element (Radix Slot); the part's attributes are merged onto it. `true` is not supported.
- `id` [String, nil] id of the root element, as in React, and the base of the generated ids (`"faq-item-1-trigger"`). Without it the element has no id and the base is `accordion-N`, numbered per request with the engine, per render without it
- `attrs` [Hash] HTML attributes merged onto the root element

Parts (class, yielded-root helper, constructor):

- `Accordion::Content` / `content`: `new(force_mount: false, style: nil, **attrs)` shadcn AccordionContent: the region div has fixed classes, the caller class goes to the inner div.
- `Accordion::Item` / `item`: `new(value:, disabled: false, as_child: false, **attrs)` Radix AccordionItem (a Collapsible root).
- `Accordion::Trigger` / `trigger`: `new(**attrs)` shadcn AccordionTrigger: Radix Header (h3) > Trigger (button) + chevron.

Stimulus: `chadcn--accordion`; values: `collapsible`, `controlled`, `dir`, `disabled`, `orientation`, `type`; events (prefixed `chadcn--accordion:`): `value-change`

Example:

```ruby
render Chadcn::Accordion.new(type: "single", collapsible: true, default_value: "a") do |acc|
  acc.item(value: "a") do
    acc.trigger { "Is it accessible?" }
    acc.content { "Yes." }
  end
end
```

<a id="component-alert"></a>
## Alert

shadcn Alert: a callout box with an optional leading `svg` icon (a direct child, styled by the classes), `Alert::Title` and `Alert::Description`.

Constructor: `Chadcn::Alert.new(variant: "default", **attrs)`

- `variant` [String, Symbol] one of the keys of `VARIANTS` (underscores read as dashes)
- `attrs` [Hash] extra HTML attributes; `class` is merged with the defaults (Tailwind conflicts resolved, yours win), `data`/`aria` are deep-merged

- VARIANTS: `default`, `destructive`

Parts (class, yielded-root helper, constructor):

- `Alert::Description` / `description`: `new(**attrs)` The alert body text (`div data-slot="alert-description"`).
- `Alert::Title` / `title`: `new(**attrs)` The alert heading (`div data-slot="alert-title"`).

Example:

```ruby
Chadcn::Alert.new(variant: :destructive) { |alert| alert.title { "Heads up" }; alert.description { "Something broke." } }
```

<a id="component-alert-dialog"></a>
## AlertDialog

shadcn AlertDialog (Radix AlertDialog, always modal).

Constructor: `Chadcn::AlertDialog.new(open: nil, default_open: false, id: nil, **attrs)`

- `open` [Boolean, nil] controlled open state when not nil (user actions only dispatch open-change; the caller updates it)
- `default_open` [Boolean] initial open state when uncontrolled
- `id` [String, nil] id of the content (what the trigger controls); the other generated ids derive from it (`"x-title"`, `"x-description"`). Default `alert-dialog-N`, numbered per request with the engine, per render without it
- `attrs` [Hash] HTML attributes merged into the host element

Parts (class, yielded-root helper, constructor):

- `AlertDialog::Action` / `action`: `new(variant: nil, size: "default", as_child: false, **attrs)` shadcn AlertDialogAction: closes (Radix DialogClose, ad:85).
- `AlertDialog::Cancel` / `cancel`: `new(variant: nil, size: "default", as_child: false, **attrs)` shadcn AlertDialogCancel: closes and receives the open auto focus (ad:92-94).
- `AlertDialog::Content` / `content`: `new(size: "default", force_mount: false, as_child: false, **attrs)` Portal + Overlay + content panel (`role=alertdialog`) of the alert dialog; no close button.
- `AlertDialog::Description` / `description`: `new(as_child: false, **attrs)` shadcn AlertDialogDescription.
- `AlertDialog::Footer` / `footer`: `new(**attrs)` shadcn AlertDialogFooter.
- `AlertDialog::Header` / `header`: `new(**attrs)` shadcn AlertDialogHeader.
- `AlertDialog::Media` / `media`: `new(**attrs)` shadcn AlertDialogMedia.
- `AlertDialog::Overlay` / `overlay`: `new(force_mount: false, as_child: false, **attrs)` shadcn AlertDialogOverlay.
- `AlertDialog::Portal` / `portal`: `new(force_mount: false, container: nil)` Radix AlertDialogPortal: renders no element.
- `AlertDialog::Title` / `title`: `new(as_child: false, **attrs)` shadcn AlertDialogTitle.
- `AlertDialog::Trigger` / `trigger`: `new(as_child: false, **attrs)` Radix AlertDialogTrigger: toggles the dialog.

Stimulus: `chadcn--alert-dialog`; values: `controlled`, `id`, `modal`, `open`; events (prefixed `chadcn--alert-dialog:`): `close-auto-focus`, `escape-key-down`, `focus-outside`, `interact-outside`, `open-auto-focus`, `open-change`, `pointer-down-outside`

Example:

```ruby
render Chadcn::AlertDialog.new do
  render Chadcn::AlertDialog::Trigger.new { "Open" }
  render Chadcn::AlertDialog::Content.new do
    render(Chadcn::AlertDialog::Title.new { "Title" })
  end
end
```

<a id="component-aspect-ratio"></a>
## AspectRatio

shadcn AspectRatio over Radix AspectRatio: a box that keeps a width/height `ratio` and positions its content to fill it.

Constructor: `Chadcn::AspectRatio.new(ratio: 1, as_child: false, style: nil, **attrs)`

- `ratio` [Numeric] positive width / height of the box
- `as_child` [Boolean, Symbol, Chadcn::Base] render this element (a tag name or component instance) instead of the default one (Radix `asChild`)
- `style` [String, Hash, nil] caller styles, applied before the positioning styles
- `attrs` [Hash] attributes of the inner, absolutely positioned element (the wrapper only carries `data-radix-aspect-ratio-wrapper`); `class` is applied verbatim (no Tailwind merge), `data`/`aria` are deep-merged

Example:

```ruby
Chadcn::AspectRatio.new(ratio: 16.0 / 9) { img(src: "/cover.jpg", class: "size-full object-cover") }
```

<a id="component-attachment"></a>
## Attachment

shadcn Attachment: an uploaded-file chip with a `state` (idle, uploading, processing, error, done).

Constructor: `Chadcn::Attachment.new(state: "done", size: "default", orientation: "horizontal", **attrs)`

- `state` [String, Symbol] one of `idle`, `uploading`, `processing`, `error`, `done`
- `size` [String, Symbol] one of the keys of `SIZES`
- `orientation` [String, Symbol] `horizontal` or `vertical`
- `attrs` [Hash] extra HTML attributes; `class` is merged with the defaults (Tailwind conflicts resolved, yours win), `data`/`aria` are deep-merged

- ORIENTATIONS: `horizontal`, `vertical`
- SIZES: `default`, `sm`, `xs`
- STATES: `idle`, `uploading`, `processing`, `error`, `done`

Parts (class, yielded-root helper, constructor):

- `Attachment::Action` / `action`: `new(variant: nil, size: "icon-xs", **attrs)` An icon `Chadcn::Button` (`ghost`, `icon-xs` by default) inside the actions area.
- `Attachment::Actions` / `actions`: `new(**attrs)` Container for `Attachment::Action` buttons.
- `Attachment::Content` / `content`: `new(**attrs)` Title and description column.
- `Attachment::Description` / `description`: `new(**attrs)` Size or error text (`span`).
- `Attachment::Group` / `group`: `new(**attrs)` A horizontally scrolling row of attachments.
- `Attachment::Media` / `media`: `new(variant: "icon", **attrs)` Leading icon or image thumbnail.
- `Attachment::Title` / `title`: `new(**attrs)` File name (`span`, shimmers while uploading or processing).
- `Attachment::Trigger` / `trigger`: `new(as_child: false, type: nil, **attrs)` Invisible full-area button that makes the whole attachment clickable.

Example:

```ruby
Chadcn::Attachment.new(state: :uploading) { |a| a.media { "i" }; a.content { a.title { "report.pdf" } } }
```

<a id="component-avatar"></a>
## Avatar

shadcn Avatar over Radix Avatar: a round user picture that shows its `Avatar::Fallback` until the `Avatar::Image` has loaded.

Constructor: `Chadcn::Avatar.new(size: "default", as_child: false, **attrs)`

- `size` [String, Symbol, nil] one of `SIZES`; nil means `default`
- `as_child` [Boolean, Symbol, Chadcn::Base] render this element (a tag name or component instance) instead of the default one (Radix `asChild`)
- `attrs` [Hash] extra HTML attributes; `class` is merged with the defaults (Tailwind conflicts resolved, yours win), `data`/`aria` are deep-merged

- SIZES: `default`, `sm`, `lg`

Parts (class, yielded-root helper, constructor):

- `Avatar::Badge` / `badge`: `new(**attrs)` A small status dot (or tiny icon) anchored to the bottom-right corner of the avatar.
- `Avatar::Fallback` / `fallback`: `new(delay_ms: nil, as_child: false, **attrs)` Shown while the image is missing or loading (initials, an icon).
- `Avatar::Group` / `group`: `new(**attrs)` Overlaps several avatars in a row.
- `Avatar::GroupCount` / `group_count`: `new(**attrs)` The "+3" bubble that closes an `Avatar::Group`.
- `Avatar::Image` / `image`: `new(src: nil, as_child: false, **attrs)` The avatar picture; mounted by the Stimulus controller once the image has loaded (kept in an inert `template` until then).

Stimulus: `chadcn--avatar`; events (prefixed `chadcn--avatar:`): `loading-status-change`

Example:

```ruby
Chadcn::Avatar.new(size: :lg) { |avatar| avatar.image(src: "/me.png", alt: "Me"); avatar.fallback { "ME" } }
```

<a id="component-badge"></a>
## Badge

shadcn Badge: a small status label.

Constructor: `Chadcn::Badge.new(variant: "default", as_child: false, **attrs)`

- `variant` [String, Symbol] one of the keys of `VARIANTS` (underscores read as dashes)
- `as_child` [Boolean, Symbol, Chadcn::Base] render this element (a tag name or component instance) instead of the default one (Radix `asChild`)
- `attrs` [Hash] extra HTML attributes; `class` is merged with the defaults (Tailwind conflicts resolved, yours win), `data`/`aria` are deep-merged

- VARIANTS: `default`, `secondary`, `destructive`, `outline`, `ghost`, `link`

Example:

```ruby
Chadcn::Badge.new(variant: :secondary) { "New" }
```

<a id="component-breadcrumb"></a>
## Breadcrumb

shadcn Breadcrumb (new-york-v4).

Constructor: `Chadcn::Breadcrumb.new(**attrs)`

- `attrs` [Hash] HTML attributes for the `nav` (the `class` is emitted verbatim)

Parts (class, yielded-root helper, constructor):

- `Breadcrumb::Ellipsis` / `ellipsis`: `new(label: "More", **attrs)` A collapsed-items marker: ellipsis icon plus a screen-reader label.
- `Breadcrumb::Item` / `item`: `new(**attrs)` An `li` wrapping a link, the current page or an ellipsis.
- `Breadcrumb::Link` / `link`: `new(as_child: false, **attrs)` An `a` to an ancestor page.
- `Breadcrumb::List` / `list`: `new(**attrs)` The `ol` that holds the items.
- `Breadcrumb::Page` / `page`: `new(**attrs)` The current page: a `span` with `aria-current="page"`.
- `Breadcrumb::Separator` / `separator`: `new(**attrs)` An `li` separator; renders a chevron icon when the block is missing or emits nothing.

Example:

```ruby
render Chadcn::Breadcrumb.new do |bc|
  bc.list do
    bc.item { bc.link(href: "/") { "Home" } }
    bc.separator
    bc.item { bc.page { "Current" } }
  end
end
```

<a id="component-bubble"></a>
## Bubble

shadcn Bubble: one chat bubble.

Constructor: `Chadcn::Bubble.new(variant: "default", align: "start", **attrs)`

- `variant` [String, Symbol] one of the keys of `VARIANTS` (underscores read as dashes)
- `align` [String, Symbol] one of `ALIGNS`
- `attrs` [Hash] extra HTML attributes; `class` is merged with the defaults (Tailwind conflicts resolved, yours win), `data`/`aria` are deep-merged

- ALIGNS: `start`, `end`
- VARIANTS: `default`, `secondary`, `muted`, `tinted`, `outline`, `ghost`, `destructive`

Parts (class, yielded-root helper, constructor):

- `Bubble::Content` / `content`: `new(as_child: false, **attrs)` The bubble surface that holds the text.
- `Bubble::Group` / `group`: `new(**attrs)` Stacks consecutive bubbles of the same sender.
- `Bubble::Reactions` / `reactions`: `new(side: "bottom", align: "end", **attrs)` The reaction pill that overlaps the bubble edge.

Example:

```ruby
Chadcn::Bubble.new(variant: :muted, align: :end) { |bubble| bubble.content { "Hello" } }
```

<a id="component-button"></a>
## Button

A clickable button, the shadcn `Button` with its variant and size tables.

Constructor: `Chadcn::Button.new(variant: "default", size: "default", as_child: false, **attrs)`

- `variant` [String, Symbol, nil] one of VARIANTS (nil means "default")
- `size` [String, Symbol, nil] one of SIZES (nil means "default"); underscores are normalized (`:icon_sm` is `"icon-sm"`)
- `as_child` [false, Symbol, String, Chadcn::Base] the tag (`:a`) or component instance to render instead of a `<button>`, merging the button props into it; false renders the default `<button>`
- `attrs` [Hash] HTML attributes (`type:`, `disabled:`, `class:`, `data:`, `aria:`...)

- SIZES: `default`, `xs`, `sm`, `lg`, `icon`, `icon-xs`, `icon-sm`, `icon-lg`
- VARIANTS: `default`, `destructive`, `outline`, `secondary`, `ghost`, `link`

Example:

```ruby
render Chadcn::Button.new(variant: "outline") { "Save" }
```

<a id="component-button-group"></a>
## ButtonGroup

Groups related buttons into one joined control (shadcn `ButtonGroup`).

Constructor: `Chadcn::ButtonGroup.new(orientation: nil, **attrs)`

- `orientation` [String, Symbol, nil] "horizontal" or "vertical"; nil renders no `data-orientation` (and the horizontal classes); an unknown string is emitted verbatim as `data-orientation` with no orientation classes
- `attrs` [Hash] HTML attributes merged onto the root `<div>`

- ORIENTATIONS: `horizontal`, `vertical`

Parts (class, yielded-root helper, constructor):

- `ButtonGroup::Separator` / `separator`: `new(orientation: "vertical", **attrs)` Divider between the buttons of a group; renders a `Chadcn::Separator` (helper: `group.separator`).
- `ButtonGroup::Text` / `text`: `new(as_child: false, **attrs)` Static text or label shown inside a group (helper: `group.text`).

Example:

```ruby
render Chadcn::ButtonGroup.new do |group|
  group.render Chadcn::Button.new(variant: "outline") { "Archive" }
  group.separator
  group.render Chadcn::Button.new(variant: "outline") { "Report" }
end
```

<a id="component-calendar"></a>
## Calendar

shadcn `Calendar` (new-york-v4), which wraps react-day-picker 10.

Constructor: `Chadcn::Calendar.new(mode: nil, selected: nil, default_month: nil, month: nil, today: nil, number_of_months: 1, show_outside_days: true, caption_layout: "label", button_variant: "ghost", locale: nil, week_starts_on: nil, fixed_weeks: false, show_week_number: false, disabled: nil, hidden: nil, modifiers: nil, modifiers_class_names: nil, class_names: nil, formatters: nil, components: nil, start_month: nil, end_month: nil, min: nil, max: nil, required: nil, exclude_disabled: false, reset_on_select: false, disable_navigation: false, hide_navigation: false, hide_weekdays: false, paged_navigation: false, auto_focus: false, footer: nil, dir: nil, name: nil, input: nil, label: nil, close_on_select: false, **attrs)`

- `mode` [String, Symbol, nil] `single`, `multiple`, `range` or nil (a non-interactive grid)
- `selected` [Date, Time, String, Array, Hash, nil] the initial selection: a date (single), an Array of dates (multiple) or `` from:, to: `` (range); dates are `Date`, `Time` or `YYYY-MM-DD` strings
- `default_month` [Date, Time, String, nil] first displayed month (uncontrolled)
- `month` [Date, Time, String, nil] controlled first displayed month; the caller moves it by setting the `data-chadcn--calendar-month-value` attribute
- `today` [Date, Time, String, nil] the day highlighted as today; nil uses the browser's date
- `number_of_months` [Integer] months shown side by side
- `show_outside_days` [Boolean] show the days of the neighbouring months
- `caption_layout` [String, Symbol] `label`, `dropdown`, `dropdown-months` or `dropdown-years` (`:dropdown_months` works too)
- `button_variant` [String, Symbol] Button variant of the navigation buttons
- `locale` [String, Symbol, nil] BCP 47 tag; exact for nil/`en`/`en-US` and `es`, `Intl` approximations for other tags
- `week_starts_on` [Integer, String, nil] 0..6 (0 = Sunday); nil takes it from the locale
- `fixed_weeks` [Boolean] always show six weeks per month
- `show_week_number` [Boolean] add a week number column
- `disabled` [Object] matcher(s): true, a date, an Array of dates, `` from:, to: ``, `` day_of_week: ``, `` before:, after: ``, `` after: ``, `` before: `` or an Array mixing them
- `hidden` [Object] matcher(s), like `disabled`
- `modifiers` [Hash{Symbol, String => Object}] custom modifier name => matcher(s)
- `modifiers_class_names` [Hash{Symbol, String => String}] custom modifier name => classes
- `class_names` [Hash{Symbol => String}] rdp UI key (`day`, `weekday`, `today`...) => classes; replaces the shadcn string of that key
- `formatters` [Hash{Symbol => Hash}] `format_caption`, `format_day`, `format_month_dropdown`, `format_weekday_name` or `format_year_dropdown` => `Intl.DateTimeFormat` options (plus an optional `locale:`)
- `components` [nil, Hash] only nil or an empty Hash (render overrides are not portable)
- `start_month` [Date, Time, String, nil] first month that can be navigated to
- `end_month` [Date, Time, String, nil] last month that can be navigated to
- `min` [Integer, nil] multiple: minimum days; range: minimum nights
- `max` [Integer, nil] multiple: maximum days; range: maximum nights
- `required` [Boolean, nil] whether the selection cannot be cleared (nil: not set)
- `exclude_disabled` [Boolean] range only: a range containing a disabled day restarts
- `reset_on_select` [Boolean] range only: a click on a complete range starts a new one
- `disable_navigation` [Boolean] turn the month navigation off
- `hide_navigation` [Boolean] do not render the previous/next buttons
- `hide_weekdays` [Boolean] do not render the weekday header
- `paged_navigation` [Boolean] the buttons move by `number_of_months`
- `auto_focus` [Boolean] focus the day target on connect
- `footer` [String, nil] text below the months
- `dir` [String, Symbol, nil] `ltr` or `rtl`; with `rtl` the horizontal arrow keys are reversed
- `name` [String, nil] render hidden inputs named like this inside the root (single `name`, multiple `name[]`, range `name[from]`/`name[to]`)
- `input` [String, Hash, nil] CSS selector of an external hidden input (or `` from:, to: `` selectors) that is the source of truth and receives the selection; used by the date picker composition
- `label` [String, nil] CSS selector of an element whose text shows the formatted selection (its initial text is the placeholder)
- `close_on_select` [Boolean] close the enclosing Popover after a completing selection
- `attrs` [Hash] HTML attributes of the root (`id:`, `lang:`, `aria-label:`, `data:`, `class:` merged last)

Parts (class, yielded-root helper, constructor):

- `Calendar::DayButton` / `day_button`: `new(day:, modifiers: NO_MODIFIERS, **attrs)` shadcn `CalendarDayButton` (new-york-v4): the ghost icon `Button` of one day.

Stimulus: `chadcn--calendar`; values: `config`, `month`; events (prefixed `chadcn--calendar:`): `month-change`, `select`

Example:

```ruby
render Chadcn::Calendar.new(mode: :single, selected: Date.new(2026, 3, 15))
```

<a id="component-card"></a>
## Card

shadcn Card: a bordered surface.

Constructor: `Chadcn::Card.new(**attrs)`

- `attrs` [Hash] extra HTML attributes; `class` is merged with the defaults (Tailwind conflicts resolved, yours win), `data`/`aria` are deep-merged

Parts (class, yielded-root helper, constructor):

- `Card::Action` / `action`: `new(**attrs)` Top-right slot of the header (a button, a menu trigger).
- `Card::Content` / `content`: `new(**attrs)` The card body.
- `Card::Description` / `description`: `new(**attrs)` Muted supporting text under the title.
- `Card::Footer` / `footer`: `new(**attrs)` Bottom row, typically actions.
- `Card::Header` / `header`: `new(**attrs)` Top section: places the title, description and an optional `Card::Action` on a grid.
- `Card::Title` / `title`: `new(**attrs)` The card title.

Example:

```ruby
Chadcn::Card.new { |card| card.header { card.title { "Plan" } }; card.content { "Body" } }
```

<a id="component-carousel"></a>
## Carousel

shadcn Carousel over embla-carousel.

Constructor: `Chadcn::Carousel.new(orientation: "horizontal", opts: nil, plugins: nil, set_api: nil, **attrs)`

- `orientation` [String, Symbol] "horizontal" or "vertical"
- `opts` [Hash, nil] embla options (symbol or string keys, snake_case or camelCase); `axis` is derived from `orientation`
- `plugins` [nil] not supported (JS plugin objects); any other value raises
- `set_api` [nil] not supported (a JS callback); use the controller's `api` and the `chadcn--carousel:*` events
- `attrs` [Hash] HTML attributes merged onto the root element

Parts (class, yielded-root helper, constructor):

- `Carousel::Content` / `content`: `new(**attrs)` shadcn CarouselContent: the overflow-hidden viewport (no caller attributes) around the flex container, which takes `class:` and `**attrs`.
- `Carousel::Item` / `item`: `new(**attrs)` shadcn CarouselItem: one slide.
- `Carousel::Next` / `next`: `new(label: "Next slide", variant: "outline", size: "icon", **attrs)` shadcn CarouselNext: an outline icon Button.
- `Carousel::Previous` / `previous`: `new(label: "Previous slide", variant: "outline", size: "icon", **attrs)` shadcn CarouselPrevious: an outline icon Button.

Stimulus: `chadcn--carousel`; values: `opts`, `orientation`; events (prefixed `chadcn--carousel:`): `api`, `reinit`, `select`, `settle`

Example:

```ruby
render Chadcn::Carousel.new(class: "w-full max-w-xs") do |carousel|
  carousel.content do
    carousel.item { "1" }
    carousel.item { "2" }
  end
  carousel.previous
  carousel.next
end
```

<a id="component-checkbox"></a>
## Checkbox

A checkbox: a `<button role="checkbox">` plus the hidden form input Radix renders.

Constructor: `Chadcn::Checkbox.new(checked: nil, default_checked: false, disabled: false, required: nil, name: nil, value: "on", form: nil, **attrs)`

- `checked` [Boolean, String, Symbol, nil] controlled state: true, false or "indeterminate"; nil makes it uncontrolled
- `default_checked` [Boolean, String, Symbol] initial state when uncontrolled (same values as `checked:`)
- `disabled` [Boolean] disables the checkbox
- `required` [Boolean, nil] sets `aria-required` and the hidden input `required`
- `name` [String, nil] form field name, on the hidden input
- `value` [String] form value submitted when checked
- `form` [String, nil] id of the form the hidden input belongs to
- `attrs` [Hash] HTML attributes merged onto the button (`id:`, `class:`, `data:`, `aria:`...)

Stimulus: `chadcn--checkbox`; values: `controlled`, `indicator-html`; events (prefixed `chadcn--checkbox:`): `checked-change`

Example:

```ruby
render Chadcn::Checkbox.new(name: "terms", id: "terms", default_checked: true)
```

<a id="component-collapsible"></a>
## Collapsible

shadcn Collapsible over Radix Collapsible.

Constructor: `Chadcn::Collapsible.new(open: nil, default_open: false, disabled: false, as_child: false, id: nil, **attrs)`

- `open` [Boolean, nil] non-nil makes the collapsible controlled
- `default_open` [Boolean] initial state when uncontrolled
- `disabled` [Boolean] disables the trigger
- `as_child` [false, nil, Symbol, String, Chadcn::Base] a tag name (`:a`) or a component to render instead of the default element (Radix Slot); the part's attributes are merged onto it. `true` is not supported.
- `id` [String, nil] id of the root element, as in React, and the base of the generated ids (`"orders-content"`). Without it the element has no id and the base is `collapsible-N`, numbered per request with the engine, per render without it
- `attrs` [Hash] HTML attributes merged onto the root element

Parts (class, yielded-root helper, constructor):

- `Collapsible::Content` / `content`: `new(force_mount: false, as_child: false, style: nil, **attrs)` shadcn CollapsibleContent.
- `Collapsible::Trigger` / `trigger`: `new(as_child: false, **attrs)` shadcn CollapsibleTrigger: a Radix button with no classes of its own.

Stimulus: `chadcn--collapsible`; values: `content-id`, `controlled`, `disabled`; events (prefixed `chadcn--collapsible:`): `open-change`

Example:

```ruby
render Chadcn::Collapsible.new(default_open: false) do |c|
  c.trigger { "Toggle" }
  c.content { "Hidden body" }
end
```

<a id="component-combobox"></a>
## Combobox

shadcn Combobox (Base UI `Combobox`, not Radix).

Constructor: `Chadcn::Combobox.new(items: nil, multiple: false, value: nil, default_value: nil, input_value: nil, default_input_value: nil, open: nil, default_open: false, name: nil, form: nil, auto_complete: nil, id: nil, disabled: false, read_only: false, required: false, auto_highlight: false, keep_highlight: false, highlight_item_on_hover: true, loop_focus: true, open_on_input_click: true, modal: false, limit: NO_LIMIT, submit_on_item_click: false, filter: "fuzzy", locale: nil, item_to_string_label: nil, item_to_string_value: nil, item_equal_to_value: nil)`

- `items` [Array, nil] Strings, Hashes (`value:`/`label:`, extra keys allowed) or groups (`` value:, items: [...] ``); nil renders the items as static children and filters nothing
- `multiple` [Boolean] selection mode "multiple" (chips)
- `value` [Object, nil] controlled selection (an item; an Array when multiple); nil leaves the selection uncontrolled
- `default_value` [Object, nil] initial selection when uncontrolled
- `input_value` [String, nil] controlled text of the input
- `default_input_value` [String, nil] initial text of the input (single mode: the label of the selection)
- `open` [Boolean, nil] controlled popup state
- `default_open` [Boolean] initial popup state when uncontrolled
- `name` [String, nil] form field name (hidden input(s)); multiple mode submits one hidden input per selected value
- `form` [String, nil] id of the owning form
- `auto_complete` [String, nil] autocomplete attribute of the hidden input
- `id` [String, nil] id of the input, or of the trigger when the input sits inside the popup (Base UI); items are `<id>-<index>` and the hidden input `<id>-hidden-input` unless `name:` is given in single mode, then it carries the name instead. The list is `<id>-list` and the popup `<id>-popup` (the popup only when the input sits inside it).
- `disabled` [Boolean] 
- `read_only` [Boolean] the popup opens and browses but never selects
- `required` [Boolean] 
- `auto_highlight` [Boolean, String, Symbol] highlight the first match while typing; "always" also on open
- `keep_highlight` [Boolean] keep the highlight when the pointer leaves an item
- `highlight_item_on_hover` [Boolean] 
- `loop_focus` [Boolean] wrap the keyboard highlight around the ends
- `open_on_input_click` [Boolean] open the popup when the input is pressed
- `modal` [Boolean] backdrop and page scroll lock while open; focus is not trapped (recorded deviation)
- `limit` [Integer] maximum number of rendered matches (-1: all)
- `submit_on_item_click` [Boolean] submit the form after an item press
- `filter` ["fuzzy", "contains", nil] "fuzzy" ranks with the scorer primitive, "contains" is Base UI's collator substring match, nil disables filtering
- `locale` [String, nil] collator locale of the "contains" filter
- `item_to_string_label` [#call, nil] item => label, evaluated on the server
- `item_to_string_value` [#call, nil] item => form value, evaluated on the server
- `item_equal_to_value` [#call, nil] (item, value) => Boolean, evaluated on the server (default `==`)

Parts (class, yielded-root helper, constructor):

- `Combobox::Chip` / `chip`: `new(show_remove: true, **attrs)` shadcn ComboboxChip: one selected value in multiple mode (`div`) with its remove button.
- `Combobox::Chips` / `chips`: `new(**attrs)` shadcn ComboboxChips: the container of the chips and the chips input in multiple mode (`div`; `role="toolbar"` while something is selected).
- `Combobox::ChipsInput` / `chips_input`: `new(disabled: false, **attrs)` shadcn ComboboxChipsInput: the text field inside `Combobox::Chips` (`input`).
- `Combobox::Clear` / `clear`: `new(disabled: false, **attrs)` shadcn ComboboxClear: the button that clears the text and the selection.
- `Combobox::Collection` / `collection`: `new(**attrs)` shadcn ComboboxCollection: renders its block once per item of the enclosing `Combobox::Group` (its `items:`), or of the root.
- `Combobox::Content` / `content`: `new(side: "bottom", side_offset: 6, align: "start", align_offset: 0, anchor: nil, **attrs)` shadcn ComboboxContent: the popup (Base UI Portal > Positioner > Popup).
- `Combobox::Empty` / `empty`: `new(**attrs)` shadcn ComboboxEmpty: the "no results" live region (`div`, `role="status"`).
- `Combobox::Group` / `group`: `new(items: nil, **attrs)` shadcn ComboboxGroup: a labelled set of items (`div`, `role="group"`).
- `Combobox::Input` / `input`: `new(disabled: false, show_trigger: true, show_clear: false, **attrs)` shadcn ComboboxInput: the text field of the combobox, composed like shadcn does it (an InputGroup with the input, an addon holding the trigger and the clear button, and your block).
- `Combobox::Item` / `item`: `new(value: nil, disabled: false, **attrs)` shadcn ComboboxItem: one option (`div`, `role="option"`) with a check mark while selected.
- `Combobox::Label` / `label`: `new(**attrs)` shadcn ComboboxLabel: the heading of a `Combobox::Group` (`div`, hidden from assistive technology; the group names itself with it).
- `Combobox::List` / `list`: `new(**attrs)` shadcn ComboboxList: the listbox.
- `Combobox::Separator` / `separator`: `new(**attrs)` shadcn ComboboxSeparator: a rule between groups (`div`, `role="presentation"`).
- `Combobox::Trigger` / `trigger`: `new(as_child: false, disabled: false, **attrs)` shadcn ComboboxTrigger: the chevron button of `Combobox::Input` (rendered through `InputGroup::Button`'s `as_child:`), or, used on its own, the button that shows the selection and opens a popup holding the search `Combobox::Input`.
- `Combobox::Value` / `value`: `new(placeholder: nil)` shadcn ComboboxValue: the current selection as content.

Stimulus: `chadcn--combobox`; values: `config`, `input-value`, `open`, `selected`; events (prefixed `chadcn--combobox:`): `input-value-change`, `item-highlighted`, `open-change`, `open-change-complete`, `value-change`

Example:

```ruby
render Chadcn::Combobox.new(items: %w[Next.js SvelteKit Astro]) do
  render Chadcn::Combobox::Input.new(placeholder: "Select a framework")
  render Chadcn::Combobox::Content.new do
    render(Chadcn::Combobox::Empty.new { "No items found." })
    render Chadcn::Combobox::List.new do |item|
      render(Chadcn::Combobox::Item.new(value: item) { item })
    end
  end
end
```

<a id="component-command"></a>
## Command

shadcn Command (the React-only `cmdk` library).

Constructor: `Chadcn::Command.new(label: nil, value: nil, default_value: nil, should_filter: true, loop: false, disable_pointer_selection: false, vim_bindings: true, id: nil, **attrs)`

- `label` [String, nil] text of the sr-only label
- `value` [String, nil] controlled selected value (trimmed); the caller updates it on `value-change`
- `default_value` [String, nil] initial selected value when uncontrolled (not trimmed)
- `should_filter` [Boolean] filter and sort the items by the search (false: the caller filters)
- `loop` [Boolean] wrap the keyboard selection around the ends
- `disable_pointer_selection` [Boolean] hovering an item does not select it
- `vim_bindings` [Boolean] Ctrl+n/j/p/k move the selection
- `id` [String, nil] id of the root element, as in React, and the base of the generated ids (`"palette-input"`). Without it the element has no id and the base is `command-N`, numbered per request with the engine, per render without it
- `attrs` [Hash] HTML attributes merged into the root (class goes through tailwind-merge)

Parts (class, yielded-root helper, constructor):

- `Command::Dialog` / `dialog`: `new(title: "Command Palette", description: "Search for a command to run...", show_close_button: true, open: nil, default_open: false, modal: true, **attrs)` shadcn CommandDialog: a Command inside a Dialog (Chadcn::Dialog does all the dialog behavior).
- `Command::Empty` / `empty`: `new(**attrs)` shadcn CommandEmpty: shown while no item matches the search.
- `Command::Group` / `group`: `new(heading: nil, value: nil, force_mount: false, **attrs)` shadcn CommandGroup: a titled set of items (`div` > heading + `cmdk-group-items`).
- `Command::Input` / `input`: `new(value: nil, **attrs)` shadcn CommandInput: the search field (wrapper `div` + search icon + cmdk's `input`).
- `Command::Item` / `item`: `new(value: nil, keywords: KEYWORDS, disabled: false, force_mount: false, as_child: false, **attrs)` shadcn CommandItem: one selectable option (`div`, `role="option"`).
- `Command::List` / `list`: `new(label: "Suggestions", **attrs)` shadcn CommandList: the listbox (`div`) around cmdk's inner sizer `div`.
- `Command::Separator` / `separator`: `new(always_render: false, **attrs)` shadcn CommandSeparator: a rule between groups (`div`, `role="separator"`).
- `Command::Shortcut` / `shortcut`: `new(**attrs)` shadcn CommandShortcut: the right-aligned keyboard hint of an item (`span`).

Stimulus: `chadcn--command`; values: `controlled`, `disable-pointer-selection`, `loop`, `should-filter`, `value`, `vim-bindings`; events (prefixed `chadcn--command:`): `search-change`, `select`, `value-change`

Example:

```ruby
render Chadcn::Command.new do
  render Chadcn::Command::Input.new(placeholder: "Type a command or search...")
  render Chadcn::Command::List.new do
    render Chadcn::Command::Empty.new { "No results found." }
    render Chadcn::Command::Group.new(heading: "Suggestions") do
      render(Chadcn::Command::Item.new { "Calendar" })
    end
  end
end
```

<a id="component-context-menu"></a>
## ContextMenu

shadcn ContextMenu (Radix ContextMenu over the Menu code shared with DropdownMenu).

Constructor: `Chadcn::ContextMenu.new(open: nil, dir: nil, modal: true, id: nil)`

- `open` [Boolean, nil] `nil` (default) leaves the menu uncontrolled and closed on first render. Any non-nil value makes it controlled: it is rendered open or closed and the controller only dispatches `chadcn--context-menu:open-change`; it never flips the state itself. Radix has no default open for the root (there is no `default_open:`; passing it raises `ArgumentError` at construction)
- `dir` [String, Symbol, nil] `"ltr"` or `"rtl"` sets the direction of the menu; any other value (including `nil`) is ignored and the direction comes from the surrounding `Chadcn::Direction` provider, or `"ltr"`
- `modal` [Boolean] default `true`; passed to the controller as its `modal` value (not validated)
- `id` [String, nil] base of the generated ids: the key of the content's template and, only when given, the content's `id` (Radix renders none); the subs are "<id>-sub-N" with triggers "<id>-sub-N-trigger". The trigger carries no id. Default `context-menu-N`, numbered per request with the engine, per render without it

Parts (class, yielded-root helper, constructor):

- `ContextMenu::CheckboxItem` / `checkbox_item`: `new(checked: false, disabled: false, text_value: nil, as_child: false, **attrs)` shadcn ContextMenuCheckboxItem: a `div` with `role="menuitemcheckbox"` and a check indicator.
- `ContextMenu::Content` / `content`: `new(align_offset: 0, avoid_collisions: true, collision_padding: 0, collision_boundary: nil, sticky: "partial", hide_when_detached: false, update_position_strategy: "optimized", arrow_padding: 0, loop: false, force_mount: false, as_child: false, **attrs)` shadcn ContextMenuContent = Portal + Radix Content.
- `ContextMenu::Group` / `group`: `new(as_child: false, **attrs)` shadcn ContextMenuGroup: a `div` with `role="group"`.
- `ContextMenu::Item` / `item`: `new(variant: "default", inset: nil, disabled: false, text_value: nil, as_child: false, **attrs)` shadcn ContextMenuItem: a `div` with `role="menuitem"`.
- `ContextMenu::Label` / `label`: `new(inset: nil, as_child: false, **attrs)` shadcn ContextMenuLabel: a `div` that titles a group of items.
- `ContextMenu::Portal` / `portal`: `new(force_mount: false, container: nil)` Radix MenuPortal: renders no element.
- `ContextMenu::RadioGroup` / `radio_group`: `new(value: nil, as_child: false, **attrs)` shadcn ContextMenuRadioGroup: a `div` with `role="group"` that holds `RadioItem`s.
- `ContextMenu::RadioItem` / `radio_item`: `new(value:, disabled: false, text_value: nil, as_child: false, **attrs)` shadcn ContextMenuRadioItem: a `div` with `role="menuitemradio"` and a circle indicator.
- `ContextMenu::Separator` / `separator`: `new(as_child: false, **attrs)` shadcn ContextMenuSeparator: a `div` with `role="separator"` and horizontal orientation.
- `ContextMenu::Shortcut` / `shortcut`: `new(**attrs)` shadcn ContextMenuShortcut: a plain `span` in the oracle (no Radix primitive, so there is no `as_child` option: an `as_child:` keyword lands in `attrs` and is rendered as a literal HTML attribute) that shows a keyboard hint at the end of an item.
- `ContextMenu::Sub` / `sub`: `new(open: nil, default_open: false)` Radix MenuSub: renders no element.
- `ContextMenu::SubContent` / `sub_content`: `new(side_offset: 0, align: "start", align_offset: 0, avoid_collisions: true, collision_padding: 0, collision_boundary: nil, sticky: "partial", hide_when_detached: false, update_position_strategy: "optimized", arrow_padding: 0, loop: false, force_mount: false, as_child: false, **attrs)` Radix MenuSubContent (`role="menu"`, labelled by its SubTrigger).
- `ContextMenu::SubTrigger` / `sub_trigger`: `new(inset: nil, disabled: false, text_value: nil, as_child: false, **attrs)` shadcn ContextMenuSubTrigger: a `div` with `role="menuitem"` and `aria-haspopup="menu"` that opens its `SubContent`, followed by a chevron icon.
- `ContextMenu::Trigger` / `trigger`: `new(disabled: false, as_child: false, **attrs)` Radix ContextMenuTrigger: a `span` without classes, ids or aria that hosts the `chadcn--context-menu` controller.

Stimulus: `chadcn--context-menu`; values: `controlled`, `dir`, `long-press-delay`, `modal`, `open`, `pointer-grace-timeout`, `sub-open-delay`, `template`, `typeahead-timeout`; events (prefixed `chadcn--context-menu:`): `checked-change`, `close-auto-focus`, `escape-key-down`, `focus-outside`, `interact-outside`, `open-auto-focus`, `open-change`, `pointer-down-outside`, `select`, `value-change`

Example:

```ruby
render Chadcn::ContextMenu.new do |menu|
  menu.trigger { "Right click here" }
  menu.content(class: "w-52") do
    menu.item { "Back" }
    menu.checkbox_item(checked: true) { "Show bookmarks" }
    menu.separator
    menu.sub do
      menu.sub_trigger { "More" }
      menu.sub_content { menu.item { "Save as..." } }
    end
  end
end
```

<a id="component-dialog"></a>
## Dialog

shadcn Dialog (Radix Dialog).

Constructor: `Chadcn::Dialog.new(open: nil, default_open: false, modal: true, id: nil, **attrs)`

- `open` [Boolean, nil] controlled open state when not nil (user actions only dispatch open-change; the caller updates it)
- `default_open` [Boolean] initial open state when uncontrolled
- `modal` [Boolean] modal (overlay and focus trap) or not; default true
- `id` [String, nil] id of the content (what the trigger controls); the other generated ids derive from it (`"x-title"`, `"x-description"`). Default `dialog-N`, numbered per request with the engine, per render without it
- `attrs` [Hash] HTML attributes merged into the host element

Parts (class, yielded-root helper, constructor):

- `Dialog::Close` / `close`: `new(as_child: false, **attrs)` Radix DialogClose: no data-state and no aria attributes (dialog:305-312).
- `Dialog::Content` / `content`: `new(show_close_button: true, close_label: "Close", force_mount: false, as_child: false, **attrs)` Portal + Overlay + content panel of the dialog (+ the X close button).
- `Dialog::Description` / `description`: `new(as_child: false, **attrs)` shadcn DialogDescription.
- `Dialog::Footer` / `footer`: `new(show_close_button: false, close_label: "Close", **attrs)` shadcn DialogFooter.
- `Dialog::Header` / `header`: `new(**attrs)` shadcn DialogHeader.
- `Dialog::Overlay` / `overlay`: `new(force_mount: false, as_child: false, **attrs)` shadcn DialogOverlay.
- `Dialog::Portal` / `portal`: `new(force_mount: false, container: nil)` Radix DialogPortal: renders no element.
- `Dialog::Title` / `title`: `new(as_child: false, **attrs)` shadcn DialogTitle.
- `Dialog::Trigger` / `trigger`: `new(as_child: false, **attrs)` Radix DialogTrigger: toggles the dialog.

Stimulus: `chadcn--dialog`; values: `controlled`, `id`, `modal`, `open`; events (prefixed `chadcn--dialog:`): `close-auto-focus`, `escape-key-down`, `focus-outside`, `interact-outside`, `open-auto-focus`, `open-change`, `pointer-down-outside`

Example:

```ruby
render Chadcn::Dialog.new do
  render Chadcn::Dialog::Trigger.new { "Open" }
  render Chadcn::Dialog::Content.new do
    render(Chadcn::Dialog::Title.new { "Title" })
  end
end
```

<a id="component-direction"></a>
## Direction

shadcn/ui Direction over Radix Direction.

Constructor: `Chadcn::Direction.new(**attrs)`

- VALUES: `ltr`, `rtl`

Parts (class, yielded-root helper, constructor):

- `Direction::Provider` / `provider`: `new(dir: nil, direction: nil)` DirectionProvider: pushes the direction into the render context for consumers; emits no markup.

Example:

```ruby
render Chadcn::Direction::Provider.new(direction: :rtl) do
  render Chadcn::Tabs.new(default_value: "a") { |tabs| tabs.list { tabs.trigger(value: "a") { plain "A" } } }
end
```

<a id="component-drawer"></a>
## Drawer

shadcn Drawer (vaul over Radix Dialog).

Constructor: `Chadcn::Drawer.new(open: nil, default_open: false, direction: "bottom", dismissible: true, modal: true, handle_only: false, auto_focus: false, snap_points: nil, active_snap_point: nil, fade_from_index: nil, snap_to_sequential_point: false, close_threshold: 0.25, scroll_lock_timeout: 100, should_scale_background: false, set_background_color_on_scale: true, no_body_styles: false, fixed: false, nested: false, disable_prevent_scroll: true, prevent_scroll_restoration: false, reposition_inputs: true, container: nil, id: nil, **attrs)`

- `open` [Boolean, nil] controlled open state when not nil (user actions only dispatch open-change; the caller updates it)
- `default_open` [Boolean] initial open state when uncontrolled
- `direction` [String, Symbol, nil] edge the drawer slides from: top, bottom (default), left or right
- `dismissible` [Boolean] false ignores every request to close and disables the drag when there are no snap points
- `modal` [Boolean] false renders no overlay and lets outside presses through
- `handle_only` [Boolean] vaul only starts a drag from a Handle, which shadcn does not export: true turns the drag off
- `auto_focus` [Boolean] focus the first tabbable element on open (vaul prevents it by default)
- `snap_points` [Array<Float, String>, nil] fractions of the viewport and/or "<n>px" strings
- `active_snap_point` [Float, String, nil] controlled snap point
- `fade_from_index` [Integer, nil] first snap point with an overlay (default: the last one)
- `snap_to_sequential_point` [Boolean] never skip snap points on a fast flick
- `close_threshold` [Float] fraction of the drawer that has to be dragged away to close it
- `scroll_lock_timeout` [Integer] milliseconds a scrolled drawer ignores a drag
- `should_scale_background` [Boolean] scale the `[data-vaul-drawer-wrapper]` element while open
- `set_background_color_on_scale` [Boolean] paint the body black while the background is scaled
- `no_body_styles` [Boolean] leave the body styles alone (position fixed, background)
- `fixed` [Boolean] keep the position when the mobile keyboard opens
- `nested` [Boolean] kept for API parity
- `disable_prevent_scroll` [Boolean] iOS only: prevent the page scroll while open
- `prevent_scroll_restoration` [Boolean] Safari only: do not restore the scroll position when the URL changed
- `reposition_inputs` [Boolean] adjust the drawer when the mobile keyboard opens
- `container` [String, nil] CSS selector of the element the drawer is mounted in (default: body)
- `id` [String, nil] id of the content (what the trigger controls); the other generated ids derive from it (`"x-title"`, `"x-description"`). Default `drawer-N`, numbered per request with the engine, per render without it
- `attrs` [Hash] HTML attributes merged into the host element

- DIRECTIONS: `top`, `bottom`, `left`, `right`

Parts (class, yielded-root helper, constructor):

- `Drawer::Close` / `close`: `new(as_child: false, **attrs)` Radix DialogClose: no data-state and no aria attributes (dialog:305-312).
- `Drawer::Content` / `content`: `new(force_mount: false, as_child: false, **attrs)` vaul Content over Radix DialogContent, inside the Portal and Overlay the shadcn component renders.
- `Drawer::Description` / `description`: `new(as_child: false, **attrs)` shadcn DrawerDescription.
- `Drawer::Footer` / `footer`: `new(**attrs)` shadcn DrawerFooter.
- `Drawer::Header` / `header`: `new(**attrs)` shadcn DrawerHeader.
- `Drawer::Overlay` / `overlay`: `new(force_mount: false, as_child: false, **attrs)` vaul Overlay over Radix DialogOverlay.
- `Drawer::Portal` / `portal`: `new(force_mount: false, container: nil)` vaul Portal over Radix DialogPortal: renders no element.
- `Drawer::Title` / `title`: `new(as_child: false, **attrs)` shadcn DrawerTitle.
- `Drawer::Trigger` / `trigger`: `new(as_child: false, **attrs)` Radix DialogTrigger: toggles the drawer.

Stimulus: `chadcn--drawer`; values: `active-snap-point`, `auto-focus`, `close-threshold`, `container`, `controlled`, `direction`, `disable-prevent-scroll`, `dismissible`, `fade-from-index`, `fixed`, `handle-only`, `id`, `modal`, `nested`, `no-body-styles`, `open`, `prevent-scroll-restoration`, `reposition-inputs`, `scroll-lock-timeout`, `set-background-color-on-scale`, `should-scale-background`, `snap-points`, `snap-to-sequential-point`, `vaul-modal`; events (prefixed `chadcn--drawer:`): `active-snap-point-change`, `animation-end`, `close`, `close-auto-focus`, `drag`, `escape-key-down`, `focus-outside`, `interact-outside`, `open-auto-focus`, `open-change`, `pointer-down-outside`, `release`

Example:

```ruby
render Chadcn::Drawer.new do
  render Chadcn::Drawer::Trigger.new { "Open" }
  render Chadcn::Drawer::Content.new do
    render(Chadcn::Drawer::Title.new { "Title" })
  end
end
```

<a id="component-dropdown-menu"></a>
## DropdownMenu

shadcn DropdownMenu (Radix DropdownMenu + Menu).

Constructor: `Chadcn::DropdownMenu.new(open: nil, default_open: false, modal: true, dir: nil, id: nil)`

- `open` [Boolean, nil] non-nil makes the menu controlled: the server decides the state and user actions only dispatch `open-change`. `nil` (default) leaves the state to the controller.
- `default_open` [Boolean] initial state when uncontrolled (default `false`); ignored when `open:` is given
- `modal` [Boolean] default `true`; rendered as the controller's modal value (outside pointer events and scroll are blocked while open)
- `dir` [String, Symbol, nil] `"ltr"` or `"rtl"`. Any other value (and `nil`) is ignored without error and the direction comes from the nearest Direction::Provider, then `"ltr"`.
- `id` [String, nil] id of the content (what the trigger controls); the trigger is "<id>-trigger", the subs "<id>-sub-N" with triggers "<id>-sub-N-trigger". Default `dropdown-menu-N`, numbered per request with the engine, per render without it

Parts (class, yielded-root helper, constructor):

- `DropdownMenu::CheckboxItem` / `checkbox_item`: `new(checked: false, disabled: false, text_value: nil, as_child: false, **attrs)` Radix MenuCheckboxItem: a `div role="menuitemcheckbox"` with a check indicator.
- `DropdownMenu::Content` / `content`: `new(side: "bottom", side_offset: 4, align: "center", align_offset: 0, avoid_collisions: true, collision_padding: 0, collision_boundary: nil, sticky: "partial", hide_when_detached: false, update_position_strategy: "optimized", arrow_padding: 0, loop: false, force_mount: false, as_child: false, **attrs)` shadcn DropdownMenuContent = Portal + Radix Content.
- `DropdownMenu::Group` / `group`: `new(as_child: false, **attrs)` Radix MenuGroup: a `div role="group"` that groups related items.
- `DropdownMenu::Item` / `item`: `new(variant: "default", inset: nil, disabled: false, text_value: nil, as_child: false, **attrs)` Radix MenuItem: a `div role="menuitem"`.
- `DropdownMenu::Label` / `label`: `new(inset: nil, as_child: false, **attrs)` Radix MenuLabel: a non-interactive `div` heading for a group of items.
- `DropdownMenu::Portal` / `portal`: `new(force_mount: false, container: nil)` Radix MenuPortal: renders no element.
- `DropdownMenu::RadioGroup` / `radio_group`: `new(value: nil, as_child: false, **attrs)` Radix MenuRadioGroup: a `div role="group"`.
- `DropdownMenu::RadioItem` / `radio_item`: `new(value:, disabled: false, text_value: nil, as_child: false, **attrs)` Radix MenuRadioItem: a `div role="menuitemradio"` with a circle indicator, checked when its `value` equals the enclosing RadioGroup value (compared as strings; outside a RadioGroup it is never checked).
- `DropdownMenu::Separator` / `separator`: `new(as_child: false, **attrs)` Radix MenuSeparator: a `div role="separator"` line between items.
- `DropdownMenu::Shortcut` / `shortcut`: `new(**attrs)` A plain `span` in the oracle (no Radix primitive, so no as_child): the keyboard shortcut hint at the end of an item.
- `DropdownMenu::Sub` / `sub`: `new(open: nil, default_open: false)` Radix MenuSub: renders no element.
- `DropdownMenu::SubContent` / `sub_content`: `new(side_offset: 0, align: "start", align_offset: 0, avoid_collisions: true, collision_padding: 0, collision_boundary: nil, sticky: "partial", hide_when_detached: false, update_position_strategy: "optimized", arrow_padding: 0, loop: false, force_mount: false, as_child: false, **attrs)` Radix MenuSubContent.
- `DropdownMenu::SubTrigger` / `sub_trigger`: `new(inset: nil, disabled: false, text_value: nil, as_child: false, **attrs)` Radix MenuSubTrigger: a `div role="menuitem"` that opens its Sub (click, Enter, Space or the arrow key towards the sub menu, pointer hover) and shows a trailing chevron after the content.
- `DropdownMenu::Trigger` / `trigger`: `new(as_child: false, disabled: false, **attrs)` Radix DropdownMenuTrigger: a `button` that hosts the `chadcn--dropdown-menu` controller for the root menu and all its subs.

Stimulus: `chadcn--dropdown-menu`; values: `controlled`, `dir`, `modal`, `open`, `pointer-grace-timeout`, `sub-open-delay`, `template`, `typeahead-timeout`; events (prefixed `chadcn--dropdown-menu:`): `checked-change`, `close-auto-focus`, `escape-key-down`, `focus-outside`, `interact-outside`, `open-auto-focus`, `open-change`, `pointer-down-outside`, `select`, `value-change`

Example:

```ruby
render Chadcn::DropdownMenu.new do |menu|
  menu.trigger { "Open" }
  menu.content do
    menu.label { "My account" }
    menu.separator
    menu.item { "Profile" }
    menu.item(variant: "destructive") { "Delete" }
    menu.sub do
      menu.sub_trigger { "More" }
      menu.sub_content { menu.item { "Export" } }
    end
  end
end
```

<a id="component-empty"></a>
## Empty

shadcn Empty: the empty-state block (no results, nothing here yet).

Constructor: `Chadcn::Empty.new(**attrs)`

- `attrs` [Hash] extra HTML attributes; `class` is merged with the defaults (Tailwind conflicts resolved, yours win), `data`/`aria` are deep-merged

Parts (class, yielded-root helper, constructor):

- `Empty::Content` / `content`: `new(**attrs)` Holds the call-to-action below the header.
- `Empty::Description` / `description`: `new(**attrs)` Supporting text; links inside it are underlined.
- `Empty::Header` / `header`: `new(**attrs)` Groups the media, title and description.
- `Empty::Media` / `media`: `new(variant: "default", **attrs)` The illustration slot.
- `Empty::Title` / `title`: `new(**attrs)` The empty-state heading.

Example:

```ruby
Chadcn::Empty.new { |empty| empty.header { empty.media(variant: :icon) { "i" }; empty.title { "No projects" } } }
```

<a id="component-field"></a>
## Field

A form field: lays out a label, a control, a description and an error (shadcn `Field`).

Constructor: `Chadcn::Field.new(orientation: "vertical", **attrs)`

- `orientation` [String, Symbol, nil] "vertical", "horizontal" or "responsive" (nil means "vertical"); other values are not validated: an unknown orientation renders no orientation classes
- `attrs` [Hash] HTML attributes merged onto the root `<div>` (`class:`, `data:`, `aria:`...)

- ORIENTATIONS: `vertical`, `horizontal`, `responsive`

Parts (class, yielded-root helper, constructor):

- `Field::Content` / `content`: `new(**attrs)` Column holding a label and a description beside a control (helper: `field.content`).
- `Field::Description` / `description`: `new(**attrs)` Helper text under a control, a `<p>` (helper: `field.description`).
- `Field::Error` / `error`: `new(errors: nil, **attrs)` Validation messages, a `role="alert"` `<div>` (helper: `field.error`).
- `Field::Group` / `group`: `new(**attrs)` Stacks fields and acts as the container-query scope of responsive fields (helper: `field.group`).
- `Field::Label` / `label`: `new(**attrs)` The label of a field; renders a `Chadcn::Label` with `data-slot="field-label"` (helper: `field.label`).
- `Field::Legend` / `legend`: `new(variant: "legend", **attrs)` Caption of a Set, a `<legend>` (helper: `field.legend`).
- `Field::Separator` / `separator`: `new(**attrs)` A rule between fields with optional centered text (helper: `field.separator`).
- `Field::Set` / `set`: `new(**attrs)` Groups related fields in a `<fieldset>` (helper: `field.set`).
- `Field::Title` / `title`: `new(**attrs)` Label-looking text that is not a `<label>`, a `<div>` (helper: `field.title`).

Example:

```ruby
render Chadcn::Field.new do |field|
  field.label(html_for: "email") { "Email" }
  field.render Chadcn::Input.new(id: "email", type: "email")
  field.description { "We never share it." }
end
```

<a id="component-hover-card"></a>
## HoverCard

shadcn HoverCard (Radix HoverCard).

Constructor: `Chadcn::HoverCard.new(open: nil, default_open: false, open_delay: 700, close_delay: 300, id: nil)`

- `open` [Boolean, nil] controlled open state when not nil
- `default_open` [Boolean] initial open state when uncontrolled
- `open_delay` [Integer] ms before opening on hover (default 700)
- `close_delay` [Integer] ms before closing after leaving (default 300)
- `id` [String, nil] key of the content's template, by which the trigger finds the card; no element carries it as an id (Radix wires none). Default `hover-card-N`, numbered per request with the engine, per render without it

Parts (class, yielded-root helper, constructor):

- `HoverCard::Content` / `content`: `new(side: "bottom", side_offset: 4, align: "center", align_offset: 0, avoid_collisions: true, collision_padding: 0, collision_boundary: nil, arrow_padding: 0, sticky: "partial", hide_when_detached: false, update_position_strategy: "optimized", force_mount: false, **attrs)` Floating card.
- `HoverCard::Trigger` / `trigger`: `new(as_child: false, **attrs)` The link that opens the card on hover/focus (renders an `a` and hosts the controller).

Stimulus: `chadcn--hover-card`; values: `close-delay`, `controlled`, `open`, `open-delay`, `template-key`; events (prefixed `chadcn--hover-card:`): `escape-key-down`, `focus-outside`, `interact-outside`, `open-change`, `pointer-down-outside`

Example:

```ruby
render Chadcn::HoverCard.new do
  render Chadcn::HoverCard::Trigger.new(href: "/u/1") { "@ada" }
  render Chadcn::HoverCard::Content.new { "Profile" }
end
```

<a id="component-input"></a>
## Input

shadcn `Input` (new-york-v4).

Constructor: `Chadcn::Input.new(type: nil, default_value: nil, **attrs)`

- `type` [String, Symbol, nil] the HTML input type; nil omits the attribute
- `default_value` [String, nil] initial value, rendered as the `value` attribute (an explicit `value:` wins)
- `attrs` [Hash] HTML attributes (`name:`, `placeholder:`, `disabled:`, `class:`, `data:`, `aria:`...)

Example:

```ruby
render Chadcn::Input.new(type: "email", name: "email", placeholder: "you@example.com")
```

<a id="component-input-group"></a>
## InputGroup

Wraps an input with leading or trailing addons, buttons and text (shadcn `InputGroup`).

Constructor: `Chadcn::InputGroup.new(**attrs)`

- `attrs` [Hash] HTML attributes merged onto the root `<div>`

Parts (class, yielded-root helper, constructor):

- `InputGroup::Addon` / `addon`: `new(align: "inline-start", **attrs)` Content placed beside or above/below the control (helper: `group.addon`).
- `InputGroup::Button` / `button`: `new(type: "button", variant: "ghost", size: "xs", as_child: false, **attrs)` A small button for an addon; renders a `Chadcn::Button` with its own size table (helper: `group.button`).
- `InputGroup::Input` / `input`: `new(**attrs)` The borderless `Chadcn::Input` of the group, marked `data-slot="input-group-control"` (helper: `group.input`).
- `InputGroup::Text` / `text`: `new(**attrs)` Muted inline text (a unit, a prefix) inside an addon (helper: `group.text`).
- `InputGroup::Textarea` / `textarea`: `new(**attrs)` The borderless `Chadcn::Textarea` of the group, marked `data-slot="input-group-control"` (helper: `group.textarea`).

Stimulus: `chadcn--input-group`

Example:

```ruby
render Chadcn::InputGroup.new do |group|
  group.input(placeholder: "Search...")
  group.addon(align: "inline-end") { group.button(size: "xs") { "Go" } }
end
```

<a id="component-input-otp"></a>
## InputOtp

shadcn InputOTP (the React-only `input-otp` 1.5.0 library).

Constructor: `Chadcn::InputOtp.new(max_length:, value: nil, default_value: nil, pattern: nil, placeholder: nil, input_mode: "numeric", text_align: "left", push_password_manager_strategy: "increase-width", no_script_css_fallback: NO_SCRIPT_CSS_FALLBACK, nonce: nil, container_class_name: nil, **attrs)`

- `max_length` [Integer] number of slots and the input's maxlength
- `value` [String, nil] controlled value (nil: uncontrolled)
- `default_value` [String, nil] initial value when uncontrolled
- `pattern` [String, nil] JS regexp source every typed value must match (see REGEXP_ONLY_DIGITS)
- `placeholder` [String, nil] rendered as aria-placeholder only
- `input_mode` [String, Symbol] the input's inputmode
- `text_align` [String, Symbol] "left", "center" or "right"
- `push_password_manager_strategy` [String, Symbol] "increase-width", "experimental-no-flickering" or "none"
- `no_script_css_fallback` [String, nil] trusted CSS of the `<noscript>` fallback, rendered unescaped (never user input); must not contain `</`; nil renders none
- `nonce` [String, nil] CSP nonce of the stylesheet the controller injects
- `container_class_name` [String, nil] classes of the container, merged after the defaults
- `attrs` [Hash] HTML attributes of the input (`id:`, `name:`, `disabled:`, `aria:`, `data:`...); `class:` is merged after the input defaults

Parts (class, yielded-root helper, constructor):

- `InputOtp::Group` / `group`: `new(**attrs)` shadcn InputOTPGroup: a row of slots.
- `InputOtp::Separator` / `separator`: `new(**attrs)` shadcn InputOTPSeparator.
- `InputOtp::Slot` / `slot`: `new(index:, **attrs)` shadcn InputOTPSlot: one character box.

Stimulus: `chadcn--input-otp`; values: `controlled`, `max-length`, `nonce`, `pattern`, `push-password-manager-strategy`; events (prefixed `chadcn--input-otp:`): `change`, `complete`

Example:

```ruby
render Chadcn::InputOtp.new(max_length: 6, pattern: Chadcn::InputOtp::REGEXP_ONLY_DIGITS) do |otp|
  otp.group do
    3.times { |index| otp.slot(index: index) }
  end
  otp.separator
  otp.group do
    3.times { |index| otp.slot(index: index + 3) }
  end
end
```

<a id="component-item"></a>
## Item

shadcn Item: a flexible list row (media, content, actions).

Constructor: `Chadcn::Item.new(variant: "default", size: "default", as_child: false, **attrs)`

- `variant` [String, Symbol] one of the keys of `VARIANTS` (underscores read as dashes)
- `size` [String, Symbol] one of the keys of `SIZES`
- `as_child` [Boolean, Symbol, Chadcn::Base] render this element (a tag name or component instance) instead of the default one (Radix `asChild`)
- `attrs` [Hash] extra HTML attributes; `class` is merged with the defaults (Tailwind conflicts resolved, yours win), `data`/`aria` are deep-merged

- SIZES: `default`, `sm`
- VARIANTS: `default`, `outline`, `muted`

Parts (class, yielded-root helper, constructor):

- `Item::Actions` / `actions`: `new(**attrs)` Trailing buttons.
- `Item::Content` / `content`: `new(**attrs)` Title and description column.
- `Item::Description` / `description`: `new(**attrs)` A `p` with the item description (clamped to two lines).
- `Item::Footer` / `footer`: `new(**attrs)` Full-width row below the content.
- `Item::Group` / `group`: `new(**attrs)` A `role="list"` wrapper that stacks items.
- `Item::Header` / `header`: `new(**attrs)` Full-width row above the content.
- `Item::Media` / `media`: `new(variant: "default", **attrs)` Leading icon or image of an `Item`.
- `Item::Separator` / `separator`: `new(**attrs)` A horizontal `Chadcn::Separator` between items (`class: "my-0"`).
- `Item::Title` / `title`: `new(**attrs)` The item title.

Example:

```ruby
Chadcn::Item.new(variant: :outline) { |item| item.content { item.title { "Invoice" }; item.description { "Due Friday" } } }
```

<a id="component-menubar"></a>
## Menubar

shadcn Menubar over Radix Menubar + Menu: a horizontal bar of menus, each opened from a `Trigger`.

Constructor: `Chadcn::Menubar.new(value: nil, default_value: nil, loop: true, dir: nil, as_child: false, id: nil, **attrs)`

- `value` [String, Symbol, nil] the open menu (a Menu `value:`); non-nil makes the root controlled: the server decides the open menu and user actions only dispatch `value-change`. Default `nil` (uncontrolled)
- `default_value` [String, Symbol, nil] the menu open at first render when uncontrolled. Default `nil` (all closed)
- `loop` [Boolean] whether arrow-key navigation among the triggers wraps around. Default `true`
- `dir` [String, Symbol, nil] `"ltr"` or `"rtl"`; any other value is ignored and the Direction provider (else `ltr`) applies. It is not rendered as a `dir` attribute
- `as_child` [false, Symbol, String, Chadcn::Base] `false` renders the default `div`; a tag Symbol/String or a component instance renders that element carrying the bar attributes instead
- `id` [String, nil] id of the root element, as in React, and the base of the generated ids (`"bar-menu-1-trigger"`). Without it the element has no id and the base is `menubar-N`, numbered per request with the engine, per render without it
- `attrs` [Hash] extra HTML attributes; `class` is merged with `CLASSES`, `data`/`aria` are deep merged (yours win)

Parts (class, yielded-root helper, constructor):

- `Menubar::CheckboxItem` / `checkbox_item`: `new(checked: false, disabled: false, text_value: nil, as_child: false, **attrs)` A menu item with a checked state (`role="menuitemcheckbox"`).
- `Menubar::Content` / `content`: `new(side: "bottom", side_offset: 8, align: "start", align_offset: -4, avoid_collisions: true, collision_padding: 0, collision_boundary: nil, sticky: "partial", hide_when_detached: false, update_position_strategy: "optimized", arrow_padding: 0, loop: false, force_mount: false, as_child: false, **attrs)` shadcn MenubarContent = Portal + Radix Content: the popup holding the items of one `Menu`.
- `Menubar::Group` / `group`: `new(as_child: false, **attrs)` A plain grouping of items (`role="group"`, `data-slot="menubar-group"`).
- `Menubar::Item` / `item`: `new(variant: "default", inset: nil, disabled: false, text_value: nil, as_child: false, **attrs)` A menu item (`role="menuitem"`).
- `Menubar::Label` / `label`: `new(inset: nil, as_child: false, **attrs)` A non-interactive label for a group of items (`data-slot="menubar-label"`).
- `Menubar::Menu` / `menu`: `new(value: nil)` Radix MenubarMenu: renders no element, it groups one `Trigger` with its `Content`.
- `Menubar::Portal` / `portal`: `new(force_mount: false, container: nil)` Radix MenuPortal: renders no element.
- `Menubar::RadioGroup` / `radio_group`: `new(value: nil, as_child: false, **attrs)` A group of `RadioItem`s (`role="group"`).
- `Menubar::RadioItem` / `radio_item`: `new(value:, disabled: false, text_value: nil, as_child: false, **attrs)` A menu item that is one of a `RadioGroup` (`role="menuitemradio"`).
- `Menubar::Separator` / `separator`: `new(as_child: false, **attrs)` A horizontal divider between items (`role="separator"`).
- `Menubar::Shortcut` / `shortcut`: `new(**attrs)` A keyboard-shortcut hint, a plain `span` in the oracle (no Radix primitive, so no `as_child`).
- `Menubar::Sub` / `sub`: `new(open: nil, default_open: false)` Radix MenuSub: renders no element, it groups a `SubTrigger` with its `SubContent`.
- `Menubar::SubContent` / `sub_content`: `new(side_offset: 0, align: "start", align_offset: 0, avoid_collisions: true, collision_padding: 0, collision_boundary: nil, sticky: "partial", hide_when_detached: false, update_position_strategy: "optimized", arrow_padding: 0, loop: false, force_mount: false, as_child: false, **attrs)` Radix MenuSubContent: the popup of a `Sub`.
- `Menubar::SubTrigger` / `sub_trigger`: `new(inset: nil, disabled: false, text_value: nil, as_child: false, **attrs)` The item that opens a `Sub` (`role="menuitem"`, `aria-haspopup="menu"`), with a trailing chevron icon.
- `Menubar::Trigger` / `trigger`: `new(disabled: false, as_child: false, **attrs)` Radix MenubarTrigger: a `button` that is a roving item of the root group and the anchor of its `Menu`.

Stimulus: `chadcn--menubar`; values: `controlled`, `dir`, `loop`, `pointer-grace-timeout`, `sub-open-delay`, `typeahead-timeout`, `value`; events (prefixed `chadcn--menubar:`): `checked-change`, `close-auto-focus`, `escape-key-down`, `focus-outside`, `interact-outside`, `open-auto-focus`, `open-change`, `pointer-down-outside`, `select`, `value-change`

Example:

```ruby
render Chadcn::Menubar.new do |bar|
  bar.menu(value: "file") do
    bar.trigger { "File" }
    bar.content do
      bar.item { "New" }
      bar.separator
      bar.checkbox_item(checked: true) { "Show toolbar" }
      bar.radio_group(value: "list") do
        bar.radio_item(value: "list") { "List" }
        bar.radio_item(value: "grid") { "Grid" }
      end
      bar.sub do
        bar.sub_trigger { "Share" }
        bar.sub_content { bar.item { "Email" } }
      end
    end
  end
end
```

<a id="component-message"></a>

- `attrs` [Hash] extra HTML attributes; `class` is merged with the defaults (Tailwind conflicts resolved, yours win), `data`/`aria` are deep-merged

- ALIGNS: `start`, `end`

Parts (class, yielded-root helper, constructor):

- `Message::Avatar` / `avatar`: `new(**attrs)` The sender avatar slot.
- `Message::Content` / `content`: `new(**attrs)` Column holding the header, bubble(s) and footer.
- `Message::Footer` / `footer`: `new(**attrs)` Small line below the bubble (time, status).
- `Message::Group` / `group`: `new(**attrs)` Stacks consecutive messages of the same sender.

<a id="component-native-select"></a>
## NativeSelect

shadcn NativeSelect (new-york-v4).

Constructor: `Chadcn::NativeSelect.new(size: "default", default_value: nil, value: nil, **attrs)`

- `size` [String, Symbol] `"default"` or `"sm"`, rendered as `data-size`; other values are rendered as-is in `data-size`
- `default_value` [String, Array<String>, nil] value(s) whose options render `selected`
- `value` [String, Array<String>, nil] same as `default_value`, takes precedence when not nil
- `attrs` [Hash] HTML attributes for the `<select>` (`name:`, `multiple:`, `class:` merged last, `aria:`, `data:`)

Parts (class, yielded-root helper, constructor):
