- `NativeSelect::Option` / `option`: `new(**attrs)` An `<option>`.

Example:

```ruby
render Chadcn::NativeSelect.new(name: "role", default_value: "editor", aria: { label: "Role" }) do |select|
  select.option(value: "author") { "Author" }
  select.opt_group(label: "Staff") do
    select.option(value: "editor") { "Editor" }
  end
end
```

<a id="component-navigation-menu"></a>
## NavigationMenu

shadcn NavigationMenu over Radix NavigationMenu.

Constructor: `Chadcn::NavigationMenu.new(viewport: true, value: nil, default_value: "", delay_duration: 200, skip_delay_duration: 300, orientation: "horizontal", dir: nil, activation_mode: "automatic", id: nil, **attrs)`

- `viewport` [Boolean] render the shared viewport that hosts the open content (default: true)
- `value` [String, nil] open item value; non-nil makes the menu controlled (default: nil)
- `default_value` [String] initially open item value when uncontrolled (default: "")
- `delay_duration` [Integer] milliseconds before hovering opens an item (default: 200)
- `skip_delay_duration` [Integer] milliseconds after closing during which hovering opens instantly (default: 300)
- `orientation` [String, Symbol] `horizontal` or `vertical`; any other value silently falls back to `horizontal` (default: "horizontal")
- `dir` [String, Symbol, nil] `ltr` or `rtl`; defaults to the nearest `Chadcn::Direction::Provider` (default: nil)
- `activation_mode` [String, Symbol] `automatic` (hover or focus opens) or `manual`; passed to the Stimulus controller as given, without validation (default: "automatic")
- `id` [String, nil] id of the root element, as in React, and the base of the generated ids (`"docs-item-1"`). Without it the element has no id and the base is `navigation-menu-N`, numbered per request with the engine, per render without it
- `attrs` [Hash] HTML attributes for the root `nav`; `class:` is tailwind-merged, `data:` and `aria:` are deep-merged

- ORIENTATIONS: `horizontal`, `vertical`

Parts (class, yielded-root helper, constructor):

- `NavigationMenu::Content` / `content`: `new(force_mount: false, as_child: false, **attrs)` shadcn NavigationMenuContent: the panel of an item, shipped in an inert `template` that the controller clones.
- `NavigationMenu::Indicator` / `indicator`: `new(force_mount: false, **attrs)` shadcn NavigationMenuIndicator: the arrow under the active trigger (inert `template`, mounted by the controller).
- `NavigationMenu::Item` / `item`: `new(value: nil, as_child: false, **attrs)` shadcn NavigationMenuItem: the `li` that groups a trigger and its content under one value.
- `NavigationMenu::Link` / `link`: `new(active: false, as_child: false, **attrs)` shadcn NavigationMenuLink: the `a` of a menu entry.
- `NavigationMenu::List` / `list`: `new(as_child: false, **attrs)` shadcn NavigationMenuList: the `ul` that holds the items, inside the indicator track.
- `NavigationMenu::Trigger` / `trigger`: `new(disabled: false, **attrs)` shadcn NavigationMenuTrigger: the `button` that opens its item's content.
- `NavigationMenu::Viewport` / `viewport`: `new(force_mount: false, **attrs)` shadcn NavigationMenuViewport: the shared container that hosts the open content (inert `template`).

Stimulus: `chadcn--navigation-menu`; values: `activation-mode`, `controlled`, `delay-duration`, `dir`, `orientation`, `skip-delay-duration`, `value`; events (prefixed `chadcn--navigation-menu:`): `escape-key-down`, `focus-outside`, `link-select`, `pointer-down-outside`, `value-change`

Example:

```ruby
render Chadcn::NavigationMenu.new do |menu|
  menu.list do
    menu.item(value: "docs") do
      menu.trigger { plain "Docs" }
      menu.content { menu.link(href: "/docs") { plain "Introduction" } }
    end
    menu.item { menu.link(href: "/about", class: Chadcn::NavigationMenu.trigger_style) { plain "About" } }
  end
end
```

<a id="component-pagination"></a>
## Pagination

shadcn Pagination (new-york-v4).

Constructor: `Chadcn::Pagination.new(**attrs)`

- `attrs` [Hash] HTML attributes merged onto the `nav`

Parts (class, yielded-root helper, constructor):

- `Pagination::Content` / `content`: `new(**attrs)` The `ul` that holds the items.
- `Pagination::Ellipsis` / `ellipsis`: `new(label: "More pages", **attrs)` A collapsed-pages marker: ellipsis icon plus a screen-reader label.
- `Pagination::Item` / `item`: `new(**attrs)` An `li` wrapping a link, previous/next or an ellipsis.
- `Pagination::Link` / `link`: `new(is_active: nil, size: "icon", **attrs)` A page link, styled as a ghost (or outline when active) button.
- `Pagination::Next` / `next`: `new(label: "Next", aria_label: "Go to next page", **attrs)` Link to the next page ("Next" label plus chevron).
- `Pagination::Previous` / `previous`: `new(label: "Previous", aria_label: "Go to previous page", **attrs)` Link to the previous page (chevron plus "Previous" label).

Example:

```ruby
render Chadcn::Pagination.new do |pg|
  pg.content do
    pg.item { pg.previous(href: "?page=1") }
    pg.item { pg.link(href: "?page=2", is_active: true) { "2" } }
    pg.item { pg.next(href: "?page=3") }
  end
end
```

<a id="component-popover"></a>
## Popover

shadcn Popover (Radix Popover).

Constructor: `Chadcn::Popover.new(open: nil, default_open: false, modal: false, id: nil)`

- `open` [Boolean, nil] controlled open state when not nil
- `default_open` [Boolean] initial open state when uncontrolled
- `modal` [Boolean] modal popover (default false)
- `id` [String, nil] id of the content (what the trigger controls) and the key of its template, anchor and triggers. Default `popover-N`, numbered per request with the engine, per render without it

Parts (class, yielded-root helper, constructor):

- `Popover::Anchor` / `anchor`: `new(as_child: false, **attrs)` Optional positioning anchor (`div`) other than the Trigger.
- `Popover::Content` / `content`: `new(side: "bottom", side_offset: 4, align: "center", align_offset: 0, avoid_collisions: true, collision_padding: 0, collision_boundary: nil, arrow_padding: 0, sticky: "partial", hide_when_detached: false, update_position_strategy: "optimized", force_mount: false, **attrs)` Floating panel of the popover.
- `Popover::Description` / `description`: `new(**attrs)` Popover description (`p`).
- `Popover::Header` / `header`: `new(**attrs)` Popover header (`div`).
- `Popover::Title` / `title`: `new(**attrs)` Popover title (`div`).
- `Popover::Trigger` / `trigger`: `new(as_child: false, **attrs)` Toggles the popover (renders a `button`; the first Trigger/Content hosts the controller).

Stimulus: `chadcn--popover`; values: `content-id`, `controlled`, `modal`, `open`, `template-key`; events (prefixed `chadcn--popover:`): `close-auto-focus`, `escape-key-down`, `focus-outside`, `interact-outside`, `open-auto-focus`, `open-change`, `pointer-down-outside`

Example:

```ruby
render Chadcn::Popover.new do
  render Chadcn::Popover::Trigger.new { "Open" }
  render Chadcn::Popover::Content.new { "Body" }
end
```

<a id="component-progress"></a>
## Progress

shadcn Progress over Radix Progress.

Constructor: `Chadcn::Progress.new(value: nil, max: nil, **attrs)`

- `value` [Numeric, nil] a percentage (0-100) that positions the indicator; above 100 no style is rendered
- `max` [Numeric, nil] only exposed as `data-max` and `aria-valuemax` (ignored unless a positive number, default 100)
- `attrs` [Hash] extra HTML attributes; `class` is merged with the defaults (Tailwind conflicts resolved, yours win), `data`/`aria` are deep-merged

Example:

```ruby
Chadcn::Progress.new(value: 40)
```

<a id="component-radio-group"></a>
## RadioGroup

shadcn RadioGroup over Radix RadioGroup.

Constructor: `Chadcn::RadioGroup.new(value: nil, default_value: nil, disabled: false, required: false, name: nil, form: nil, orientation: nil, dir: nil, loop: true, as_child: false, **attrs)`

- `value` [String, nil] controlled checked value; non-nil makes the group controlled
- `default_value` [String, nil] initially checked value (uncontrolled)
- `disabled` [Boolean] disables every item
- `required` [Boolean] marks the group required (aria and bubble inputs)
- `name` [String, nil] form field name of the bubble inputs
- `form` [String, nil] id of the associated `<form>`
- `orientation` [String, Symbol, nil] one of `ORIENTATIONS`
- `dir` [String, Symbol, nil] one of `DIRECTIONS`; defaults to the surrounding direction provider
- `loop` [Boolean] whether arrow-key focus wraps around
- `as_child` [false, Symbol, String, Chadcn::Base] a tag or component instance to render instead of the `<div>`; false renders the default element
- `attrs` [Hash] HTML attributes for the root (`class:` merged last)

- DIRECTIONS: `ltr`, `rtl`
- ORIENTATIONS: `horizontal`, `vertical`

Parts (class, yielded-root helper, constructor):

- `RadioGroup::Item` / `item`: `new(value:, disabled: false, **attrs)` shadcn RadioGroupItem: Radix Item button (+ Indicator while checked) followed by the form bubble input.

Stimulus: `chadcn--radio-group`; values: `controlled`, `dir`, `indicator-html`, `loop`, `orientation`; events (prefixed `chadcn--radio-group:`): `value-change`

Example:

```ruby
render Chadcn::RadioGroup.new(name: "plan", default_value: "pro") do |group|
  group.item(value: "free", id: "plan-free")
  group.item(value: "pro", id: "plan-pro")
end
```

<a id="component-resizable"></a>
## Resizable

shadcn Resizable over react-resizable-panels (`Group`, `Panel`, `Separator`).

Constructor: `Chadcn::Resizable.new(**attrs)`

Parts (class, yielded-root helper, constructor):

- `Resizable::Handle` / `handle`: `new(with_handle: false, disabled: false, disable_double_click: false, preview: nil, id: nil, style: nil, **attrs)` shadcn ResizableHandle over react-resizable-panels `Separator`: the draggable, focusable divider between two panels.
- `Resizable::Panel` / `panel`: `new(default_size: nil, min_size: "0%", max_size: "100%", collapsible: false, collapsed_size: "0%", collapsed_threshold: nil, disabled: false, group_resize_behavior: "preserve-relative-size", id: nil, class: nil, style: nil, **attrs)` shadcn ResizablePanel over react-resizable-panels `Panel`: an outer flex item (attributes) around an inner div (`class:`, `style:` and the content), as the library renders it.
- `Resizable::PanelGroup` / `panel_group`: `new(orientation: "horizontal", default_layout: nil, disabled: false, disable_cursor: false, resize_preview_mode: "panel", resize_target_minimum_size: TARGET_SIZE, id: nil, style: nil, **attrs)` shadcn ResizablePanelGroup over react-resizable-panels `Group`: the flex container and Stimulus host.

Stimulus: `chadcn--resizable`; values: `default-layout`, `disable-cursor`, `disabled`, `orientation`, `resize-preview-mode`, `resize-target-minimum-size`; events (prefixed `chadcn--resizable:`): `layout-change`, `layout-changed`, `resize`

Example:

```ruby
render Chadcn::Resizable::PanelGroup.new(class: "h-[200px] w-[401px]") do
  render(Chadcn::Resizable::Panel.new) { "One" }
  render Chadcn::Resizable::Handle.new(with_handle: true)
  render(Chadcn::Resizable::Panel.new) { "Two" }
end
```

<a id="component-scroll-area"></a>
## ScrollArea

shadcn ScrollArea over Radix ScrollArea (Root, Viewport, Scrollbar, Thumb, Corner).

Constructor: `Chadcn::ScrollArea.new(type: "hover", dir: nil, scroll_hide_delay: 600, **attrs)`

- `type` [String, Symbol] when the scrollbars show: `auto`, `always`, `scroll` or `hover` (default: "hover")
- `dir` [String, Symbol, nil] `ltr` or `rtl`; defaults to the nearest `Chadcn::Direction::Provider` (default: nil)
- `scroll_hide_delay` [Integer] milliseconds before the scrollbars hide (default: 600)
- `attrs` [Hash] HTML attributes for the root `div`; `class:` is tailwind-merged, `style:` is appended, `data:` and `aria:` are deep-merged

- TYPES: `auto`, `always`, `scroll`, `hover`

Parts (class, yielded-root helper, constructor):

- `ScrollArea::ScrollBar` / `scroll_bar`: `new(orientation: "vertical", force_mount: false, **attrs)` Radix ScrollAreaScrollbar + Thumb.

Stimulus: `chadcn--scroll-area`; values: `scroll-hide-delay`, `type`

Example:

```ruby
render Chadcn::ScrollArea.new(type: "always", class: "h-72 w-48") do |area|
  %w[v1.2.0 v1.1.0 v1.0.0].each { |tag| div { plain tag } }
  area.scroll_bar(orientation: "horizontal")
end
```

<a id="component-select"></a>
## Select

shadcn Select (Radix Select).

Constructor: `Chadcn::Select.new(value: nil, default_value: nil, open: nil, default_open: false, dir: nil, name: nil, auto_complete: nil, form: nil, disabled: false, required: nil, id: nil)`

- `value` [String, Symbol, Integer, nil] controlled selected value (converted with `to_s`); `nil` means uncontrolled
- `default_value` [String, Symbol, Integer, nil] initial value when uncontrolled; `nil` shows the Value placeholder
- `open` [Boolean, nil] controlled open state; `nil` means uncontrolled
- `default_open` [Boolean] initial open state when uncontrolled
- `dir` [String, Symbol, nil] `"ltr"` or `"rtl"`; other values are ignored and the direction provider (or `ltr`) is used
- `name` [String, nil] when given, the Trigger also renders a visually hidden native `select` with that name; the controller keeps it only inside a form or when `form:` is set (`name:` alone outside a form submits nothing)
- `auto_complete` [String, nil] forwarded as `autocomplete` to the hidden native select
- `form` [String, nil] id of the form the hidden native select belongs to (also renders it, and keeps it outside a form)
- `disabled` [Boolean] disables the Trigger and the hidden native select
- `required` [Boolean, nil] `aria-required` on the Trigger (`nil` omits it, `false` renders `"false"`) and `required` on the hidden native select (only `true`)
- `id` [String, nil] id of the content (the listbox the trigger controls); groups and item texts are `<id>-group-N` and `<id>-text-N` (one counter). It is not the trigger's id: give `select.trigger(id:)` another value for a Label. Default `select-N`, numbered per request with the engine, per render without it

Parts (class, yielded-root helper, constructor):

- `Select::Content` / `content`: `new(position: "item-aligned", align: "center", side: "bottom", side_offset: 0, align_offset: 0, avoid_collisions: true, collision_padding: 10, collision_boundary: nil, sticky: "partial", hide_when_detached: false, arrow_padding: 0, force_mount: false, **attrs)` The popup: a `div role="listbox"` inside an inert `template` (with the viewport, the scroll buttons and a `data-options` JSON for the controller; the controller clones it into `body` when opening and creates the positioning wrapper).
- `Select::Group` / `group`: `new(as_child: false, **attrs)` Groups items: a `div role="group"` whose `aria-labelledby` points at the id that a `Chadcn::Select::Label` inside it takes.
- `Select::Item` / `item`: `new(value:, disabled: false, text_value: nil, **attrs)` Radix SelectItem + ItemIndicator + ItemText (as shadcn composes them).
- `Select::Label` / `label`: `new(as_child: false, **attrs)` Takes the id its Group points to with `aria-labelledby` (raises outside a Group, as React does).
- `Select::ScrollDownButton` / `scroll_down_button`: `new(**attrs)` Chevron-down button shown by the controller when the viewport can scroll down; until then the controller keeps the node out of the document.
- `Select::ScrollUpButton` / `scroll_up_button`: `new(**attrs)` Chevron-up button shown by the controller when the viewport can scroll up; until then the controller keeps the node out of the document.
- `Select::Separator` / `separator`: `new(as_child: false, **attrs)` A thin horizontal rule (`div aria-hidden="true"`) between groups or items.
- `Select::Trigger` / `trigger`: `new(size: "default", disabled: false, **attrs)` Renders a `button` with `role="combobox"` and the `data-controller="chadcn--select"` wiring (values mirror the root state), plus a trailing chevron icon.
- `Select::Value` / `value`: `new(placeholder: "", **attrs)` Shows the selected item's content, or the placeholder while no value is selected (the span shows the placeholder, its own block, or a copy of the selected item's HTML children).

Stimulus: `chadcn--select`; values: `auto-complete`, `content-id`, `controlled-open`, `controlled-value`, `dir`, `disabled`, `form`, `name`, `open`, `typeahead-timeout`, `value`; events (prefixed `chadcn--select:`): `close-auto-focus`, `escape-key-down`, `open-change`, `pointer-down-outside`, `value-change`

Example:

```ruby
render Chadcn::Select.new(name: "fruit", default_value: "apple") do |select|
  select.trigger(class: "w-48") { select.value(placeholder: "Pick a fruit") }
  select.content do
    select.group do
      select.label { "Fruits" }
      select.item(value: "apple") { "Apple" }
      select.item(value: "banana", disabled: true) { "Banana" }
    end
    select.separator
    select.item(value: "other") { "Other" }
  end
end
```

<a id="component-separator"></a>
## Separator

shadcn Separator over Radix Separator: a thin horizontal or vertical rule.

Constructor: `Chadcn::Separator.new(orientation: "horizontal", decorative: true, as_child: false, **attrs)`

- `orientation` [String, Symbol] `horizontal` or `vertical`; any other value falls back to `horizontal`
- `decorative` [Boolean] `true` renders `role="none"`; `false` renders `role="separator"` (plus `aria-orientation` when vertical)
- `as_child` [Boolean, Symbol, Chadcn::Base] render this element (a tag name or component instance) instead of the default one (Radix `asChild`)
- `attrs` [Hash] extra HTML attributes; `class` is merged with the defaults (Tailwind conflicts resolved, yours win), `data`/`aria` are deep-merged

- ORIENTATIONS: `horizontal`, `vertical`

Example:

```ruby
Chadcn::Separator.new(orientation: :vertical, decorative: false)
```

<a id="component-sheet"></a>
## Sheet

shadcn Sheet (Radix Dialog with side-aware styling).

Constructor: `Chadcn::Sheet.new(open: nil, default_open: false, modal: true, id: nil, **attrs)`

- `open` [Boolean, nil] controlled open state when not nil (user actions only dispatch open-change; the caller updates it)
- `default_open` [Boolean] initial open state when uncontrolled
- `modal` [Boolean] modal (overlay and focus trap) or not; default true
- `id` [String, nil] id of the content (what the trigger controls); the other generated ids derive from it (`"x-title"`, `"x-description"`). Default `sheet-N`, numbered per request with the engine, per render without it
- `attrs` [Hash] HTML attributes merged into the host element

Parts (class, yielded-root helper, constructor):

- `Sheet::Close` / `close`: `new(as_child: false, **attrs)` Radix DialogClose: no data-state and no aria attributes (dialog:305-312).
- `Sheet::Content` / `content`: `new(side: "right", show_close_button: true, close_label: "Close", force_mount: false, as_child: false, **attrs)` Portal + Overlay + side-aware content panel of the sheet (+ the X close button).
- `Sheet::Description` / `description`: `new(as_child: false, **attrs)` shadcn SheetDescription.
- `Sheet::Footer` / `footer`: `new(**attrs)` shadcn SheetFooter.
- `Sheet::Header` / `header`: `new(**attrs)` shadcn SheetHeader.
- `Sheet::Overlay` / `overlay`: `new(force_mount: false, as_child: false, **attrs)` shadcn SheetOverlay.
- `Sheet::Portal` / `portal`: `new(**attrs)` Radix DialogPortal: renders no element.
- `Sheet::Title` / `title`: `new(as_child: false, **attrs)` shadcn SheetTitle.
- `Sheet::Trigger` / `trigger`: `new(as_child: false, **attrs)` Radix DialogTrigger: toggles the sheet.

Stimulus: `chadcn--sheet`; values: `controlled`, `id`, `modal`, `open`; events (prefixed `chadcn--sheet:`): `close-auto-focus`, `escape-key-down`, `focus-outside`, `interact-outside`, `open-auto-focus`, `open-change`, `pointer-down-outside`

Example:

```ruby
render Chadcn::Sheet.new do
  render Chadcn::Sheet::Trigger.new { "Open" }
  render Chadcn::Sheet::Content.new do
    render(Chadcn::Sheet::Title.new { "Title" })
  end
end
```

<a id="component-sidebar"></a>
## Sidebar

shadcn Sidebar (new-york-v4).

Constructor: `Chadcn::Sidebar.new(side: "left", variant: "sidebar", collapsible: "offcanvas", mobile_title: "Sidebar", mobile_description: nil, **attrs)`

- `side` [String, Symbol] `left` or `right` (default: "left")
- `variant` [String, Symbol] `sidebar`, `floating` or `inset` (default: "sidebar")
- `collapsible` [String, Symbol] `offcanvas`, `icon` or `none` (default: "offcanvas")
- `mobile_title` [String] screen-reader title of the mobile sheet (default: "Sidebar")
- `mobile_description` [String, nil] screen-reader description of the mobile sheet (default: "Displays the mobile sidebar.")
- `attrs` [Hash] HTML attributes for the container `div` (the `div` itself with `collapsible: "none"`); `class:` is tailwind-merged, `data:` and `aria:` are deep-merged

- COLLAPSIBLES: `offcanvas`, `icon`, `none`
- SIDES: `left`, `right`
- VARIANTS: `sidebar`, `floating`, `inset`

Parts (class, yielded-root helper, constructor):

- `Sidebar::Content` / `content`: `new(**attrs)` shadcn SidebarContent.
- `Sidebar::Footer` / `footer`: `new(**attrs)` shadcn SidebarFooter.
- `Sidebar::Group` / `group`: `new(**attrs)` shadcn SidebarGroup.
- `Sidebar::GroupAction` / `group_action`: `new(as_child: false, **attrs)` shadcn SidebarGroupAction (no `type` attribute, like React).
- `Sidebar::GroupContent` / `group_content`: `new(**attrs)` shadcn SidebarGroupContent.
- `Sidebar::GroupLabel` / `group_label`: `new(as_child: false, **attrs)` shadcn SidebarGroupLabel.
- `Sidebar::Header` / `header`: `new(**attrs)` shadcn SidebarHeader.
- `Sidebar::Input` / `input`: `new(type: nil, **attrs)` shadcn SidebarInput: the shared Input with the sidebar sizing.
- `Sidebar::Inset` / `inset`: `new(**attrs)` shadcn SidebarInset: the page content next to the sidebar (a `main`; no data-sidebar).
- `Sidebar::Menu` / `menu`: `new(**attrs)` shadcn SidebarMenu.
- `Sidebar::MenuAction` / `menu_action`: `new(as_child: false, show_on_hover: false, **attrs)` shadcn SidebarMenuAction (no `type` attribute, like React).
- `Sidebar::MenuBadge` / `menu_badge`: `new(**attrs)` shadcn SidebarMenuBadge.
- `Sidebar::MenuButton` / `menu_button`: `new(as_child: false, is_active: false, variant: "default", size: "default", tooltip: nil, **attrs)` shadcn SidebarMenuButton.
- `Sidebar::MenuItem` / `menu_item`: `new(**attrs)` shadcn SidebarMenuItem.
- `Sidebar::MenuSkeleton` / `menu_skeleton`: `new(show_icon: false, **attrs)` shadcn SidebarMenuSkeleton.
- `Sidebar::MenuSub` / `menu_sub`: `new(**attrs)` shadcn SidebarMenuSub.
- `Sidebar::MenuSubButton` / `menu_sub_button`: `new(as_child: false, size: "md", is_active: false, **attrs)` shadcn SidebarMenuSubButton (an `a` without href unless given).
- `Sidebar::MenuSubItem` / `menu_sub_item`: `new(**attrs)` shadcn SidebarMenuSubItem.
- `Sidebar::Provider` / `provider`: `new(default_open: true, open: nil, style: nil, id: nil, **attrs)` shadcn SidebarProvider: the wrapper div, the Stimulus host and the state every other part reads (`useSidebar`).
- `Sidebar::Rail` / `rail`: `new(**attrs)` shadcn SidebarRail: the thin toggle strip on the sidebar edge.
- `Sidebar::Separator` / `separator`: `new(orientation: "horizontal", decorative: true, as_child: false, **attrs)` shadcn SidebarSeparator: the shared Separator with the sidebar colors.
- `Sidebar::Trigger` / `trigger`: `new(variant: "ghost", size: "icon", label: "Toggle Sidebar", **attrs)` shadcn SidebarTrigger: a ghost icon Button that toggles the sidebar.

Stimulus: `chadcn--sidebar`; values: `controlled`, `id`, `open`, `open-mobile`; events (prefixed `chadcn--sidebar:`): `open-change`, `open-mobile-change`
Stimulus: `chadcn--tooltip`; values: `content-id`, `controlled`, `delay-duration`, `disable-hoverable-content`, `open`, `provider-id`, `skip-delay-duration`; events (prefixed `chadcn--tooltip:`): `escape-key-down`, `open-change`, `pointer-down-outside`

Example:

```ruby
render Chadcn::Sidebar::Provider.new do
  render Chadcn::Sidebar.new(collapsible: "icon") do |sidebar|
    sidebar.header { plain "Acme" }
    sidebar.content do
      sidebar.group do
        sidebar.group_label { plain "Platform" }
        sidebar.menu do
          sidebar.menu_item do
            sidebar.menu_button(as_child: :a, is_active: true, tooltip: "Home", href: "/") { plain "Home" }
          end
        end
      end
    end
    sidebar.rail
  end
  render Chadcn::Sidebar::Inset.new { plain "Page" }
end
```

## Skeleton

shadcn Skeleton: a pulsing placeholder box; size it with `class`.

Constructor: `Chadcn::Skeleton.new(**attrs)`

- `attrs` [Hash] extra HTML attributes; `class` is merged with the defaults (Tailwind conflicts resolved, yours win), `data`/`aria` are deep-merged

```ruby
Chadcn::Skeleton.new(class: "h-4 w-40")
```

<a id="component-slider"></a>
## Slider

Single component with no nested parts: the track, range, thumbs and hidden inputs (one per thumb) are rendered internally.

Constructor: `Chadcn::Slider.new(default_value: nil, value: nil, min: 0, max: 100, step: 1, orientation: "horizontal", disabled: false, inverted: false, min_steps_between_thumbs: 0, preserve_thumb_order: false, name: nil, form: nil, dir: nil, min_label: "Minimum", max_label: "Maximum", value_label: "Value %<index>d of %<count>d", **attrs)`

- `default_value` [Array<Numeric>, nil] initial thumb values (uncontrolled); without it the slider renders two thumbs and two hidden inputs, the first at `min` and the second hidden (no `aria-valuenow`, no input value)
- `value` [Array<Numeric>, nil] controlled thumb values: an Array makes the slider controlled; any other value is ignored and the slider is uncontrolled
- `min` [Numeric] lowest value (default 0)
- `max` [Numeric] highest value (default 100)
- `step` [Numeric] value increment (default 1)
- `orientation` [String, Symbol] one of `ORIENTATIONS` (default "horizontal")
- `disabled` [Boolean] disables the slider (default false)
- `inverted` [Boolean] reverses the direction of the range
- `min_steps_between_thumbs` [Integer] minimum distance between thumbs, in steps
- `preserve_thumb_order` [Boolean] stops a dragged thumb from passing its neighbours (the controller always keeps the values sorted)
- `name` [String, nil] form field name of the hidden inputs; `name[]` is used when more than one value is present, so without `value:`/`default_value:` (two thumb elements, one value) the name stays `name`
- `form` [String, nil] id of the associated `<form>`
- `dir` [String, Symbol, nil] one of `DIRECTIONS`; the surrounding direction provider's direction is the default for horizontal sliders only
- `min_label` [String] `aria-label` of the first thumb of a two-thumb slider (default: "Minimum")
- `max_label` [String] `aria-label` of the second thumb of a two-thumb slider (default: "Maximum")
- `value_label` [String] `format` template of the thumb `aria-label` with more than two thumbs; `%<index>d` is the 1-based position and `%<count>d` the number of thumbs (default: "Value %<index>d of %<count>d")
- `attrs` [Hash] HTML attributes for the root span (`class:` merged last, `aria:`, `data:`, `style:`)

- DIRECTIONS: `ltr`, `rtl`
- ORIENTATIONS: `horizontal`, `vertical`
- THUMB_TRANSFORM: `horizontal`, `vertical`

Stimulus: `chadcn--slider`; values: `controlled`, `disabled`, `form`, `inverted`, `max`, `min`, `min-steps-between-thumbs`, `orientation`, `preserve-thumb-order`, `step`; events (prefixed `chadcn--slider:`): `value-change`, `value-commit`

Example:

```ruby
render Chadcn::Slider.new(default_value: [ 25, 75 ], max: 100, step: 5, name: "price", class: "w-64")
```

<a id="component-sonner"></a>
## Sonner

shadcn/ui Sonner (the Toaster wrapper of shadcn, over the sonner library).

Constructor: `Chadcn::Sonner.new(**options)`

- `options` [Hash] the keywords of `Chadcn::Sonner::Toaster`

- TYPES: `default`, `success`, `info`, `warning`, `error`, `loading`

Parts (class, yielded-root helper, constructor):

- `Sonner::Toast` / `toast`: `new(title: nil, description: nil, type: nil, id: nil, duration: nil, position: nil, dismissible: nil, close_button: nil, rich_colors: nil, invert: nil, icon: nil, action: nil, cancel: nil, toaster_id: nil, test_id: nil, **attrs)` A toast the server asks the `Toaster` to show.
- `Sonner::Toaster` / `toaster`: `new(position: "bottom-right", theme: "system", rich_colors: nil, expand: false, close_button: false, invert: false, duration: nil, visible_toasts: 3, gap: 14, offset: nil, mobile_offset: nil, dir: nil, hotkey: DEFAULT_HOTKEY, container_aria_label: "Notifications", swipe_directions: nil, toast_options: nil, icons: nil, style: nil, toaster_id: nil, flash: nil, toasts: nil, **attrs)` shadcn Toaster (the `Toaster` of shadcn's `sonner.tsx`): the live region the toasts are shown in.

Stimulus: `chadcn--sonner`; values: `class-name`, `close-button`, `dir`, `duration`, `expand`, `gap`, `hotkey`, `invert`, `mobile-offset`, `offset`, `position`, `rich-colors`, `style`, `swipe-directions`, `theme`, `toast-options`, `toaster-id`, `visible-toasts`; events (prefixed `chadcn--sonner:`): `action`, `cancel`

Example:

```ruby
render Chadcn::Toaster.new(flash: { notice: "Saved" }, close_button: true)
```

<a id="component-spinner"></a>
## Spinner

shadcn Spinner: a spinning `loader-circle` icon (`role="status"`, label "Loading").

Constructor: `Chadcn::Spinner.new(**attrs)`

- `attrs` [Hash] attributes for the icon; `class` is merged with the defaults, `color` is passed on as `stroke`

Example:

```ruby
Chadcn::Spinner.new(class: "size-6")
```

<a id="component-switch"></a>
## Switch

A toggle button with `role=switch`, plus a hidden checkbox so it submits with a form.

Constructor: `Chadcn::Switch.new(size: "default", checked: nil, default_checked: false, disabled: false, required: nil, name: nil, value: "on", form: nil, **attrs)`

- `size` [String, Symbol] `"default"` or `"sm"`; other values are not supported: they are rendered as-is in `data-size` without sizing classes
- `checked` [Boolean, nil] controlled state (non-nil: user input only dispatches an event, the caller re-renders)
- `default_checked` [Boolean] initial state (uncontrolled)
- `disabled` [Boolean] disables the button and the hidden checkbox, and adds `data-disabled`
- `required` [Boolean, nil] sets `aria-required` and the bubble input's `required`
- `name` [String, nil] form field name of the bubble input
- `value` [String] value submitted when on
- `form` [String, nil] id of the associated `<form>`
- `attrs` [Hash] HTML attributes for the button (`id:`, `class:` merged last, `aria:`, `data:`)

Stimulus: `chadcn--switch`; values: `controlled`; events (prefixed `chadcn--switch:`): `checked-change`

Example:

```ruby
render Chadcn::Switch.new(name: "notifications", default_checked: true, id: "notifications")
```

<a id="component-table"></a>
## Table

shadcn Table.

Constructor: `Chadcn::Table.new(**attrs)`

- `attrs` [Hash] extra HTML attributes; `class` is merged with the defaults (Tailwind conflicts resolved, yours win), `data`/`aria` are deep-merged

Parts (class, yielded-root helper, constructor):

- `Table::Body` / `body`: `new(**attrs)` `tbody`.
- `Table::Caption` / `caption`: `new(**attrs)` `caption`, shown below the table.
- `Table::Cell` / `cell`: `new(**attrs)` `td`.
- `Table::Footer` / `footer`: `new(**attrs)` `tfoot`.
- `Table::Head` / `head`: `new(**attrs)` `th` (column heading).
- `Table::Header` / `header`: `new(**attrs)` `thead`.
- `Table::Row` / `row`: `new(**attrs)` `tr`; use `data-state="selected"` to highlight it.

Example:

```ruby
Chadcn::Table.new { |t| t.header { t.row { t.head { "Name" } } }; t.body { t.row { t.cell { "Ada" } } } }
```

<a id="component-tabs"></a>
## Tabs

shadcn Tabs over Radix Tabs.

Constructor: `Chadcn::Tabs.new(value: nil, default_value: nil, orientation: "horizontal", dir: nil, activation_mode: "automatic", as_child: false, **attrs)`

- `value` [String, Symbol, nil] active tab value; non-nil makes the tabs controlled
- `default_value` [String, Symbol, nil] initially active tab when uncontrolled
- `orientation` [String, Symbol] `"horizontal"` or `"vertical"`
- `dir` [String, Symbol, nil] reading direction (`"ltr"`/`"rtl"`); falls back to the Direction provider
- `activation_mode` [String, Symbol] `"automatic"` or `"manual"` (anything else is `"automatic"`)
- `as_child` [false, nil, Symbol, String, Chadcn::Base] a tag name (`:a`) or a component to render instead of the default element (Radix Slot); the part's attributes are merged onto it. `true` is not supported.
- `attrs` [Hash] HTML attributes merged onto the root element (`id:` is the base of the trigger/panel ids)

Parts (class, yielded-root helper, constructor):

- `Tabs::Content` / `content`: `new(value:, force_mount: false, as_child: false, **attrs)` shadcn TabsContent: Radix Content over Presence.
- `Tabs::List` / `list`: `new(variant: "default", loop: true, as_child: false, **attrs)` shadcn TabsList: Radix List over the roving focus group.
- `Tabs::Trigger` / `trigger`: `new(value:, disabled: false, as_child: false, **attrs)` shadcn TabsTrigger: Radix Trigger on a roving focus item.

Stimulus: `chadcn--tabs`; values: `activation-mode`, `controlled`, `dir`, `orientation`, `value`; events (prefixed `chadcn--tabs:`): `value-change`

Example:

```ruby
render Chadcn::Tabs.new(default_value: "account") do |tabs|
  tabs.list do
    tabs.trigger(value: "account") { "Account" }
    tabs.trigger(value: "password") { "Password" }
  end
  tabs.content(value: "account") { "Account settings" }
  tabs.content(value: "password") { "Password settings" }
end
```

<a id="component-textarea"></a>
## Textarea

shadcn `Textarea` (new-york-v4).

Constructor: `Chadcn::Textarea.new(default_value: nil, value: nil, **attrs)`

- `default_value` [#to_s, nil] initial text
- `value` [#to_s, nil] text, takes precedence over `default_value`
- `attrs` [Hash] HTML attributes for the `<textarea>` (`name:`, `rows:`, `class:` merged last, `aria:`)

Example:

```ruby
render Chadcn::Textarea.new(name: "bio", rows: 4, placeholder: "Tell us about you", default_value: user.bio)
```

<a id="component-toggle"></a>
## Toggle

A two-state button (`aria-pressed`).

Constructor: `Chadcn::Toggle.new(variant: "default", size: "default", pressed: nil, default_pressed: false, disabled: false, as_child: false, **attrs)`

- `variant` [String, Symbol, nil] a key of `VARIANTS`; underscores are normalized to dashes, nil means "default"
- `size` [String, Symbol, nil] a key of `SIZES`; underscores are normalized to dashes, nil means "default"
- `pressed` [Boolean, nil] controlled state (non-nil: user input only dispatches an event, the caller re-renders)
- `default_pressed` [Boolean] initial state (uncontrolled)
- `disabled` [Boolean] disables the button (`disabled` attribute and `data-disabled`)
- `as_child` [false, Symbol, String, Chadcn::Base] a tag or component instance to render instead of the `<button>`; false renders the default element
- `attrs` [Hash] HTML attributes for the root (`class:` merged last, `aria:`, `data:`)

- SIZES: `default`, `sm`, `lg`
- VARIANTS: `default`, `outline`

Stimulus: `chadcn--toggle`; values: `controlled`, `disabled`; events (prefixed `chadcn--toggle:`): `pressed-change`

Example:

```ruby
render Chadcn::Toggle.new(variant: :outline, size: :sm, aria: { label: "Bold" }) { "B" }
```

<a id="component-toggle-group"></a>
## ToggleGroup

shadcn ToggleGroup over Radix ToggleGroup.

Constructor: `Chadcn::ToggleGroup.new(type:, value: nil, default_value: nil, variant: nil, size: nil, spacing: 0, disabled: false, roving_focus: true, orientation: nil, dir: nil, loop: true, as_child: false, **attrs)`

- `type` [String, Symbol] one of `TYPES`: `single` (radio-like) or `multiple` (toolbar)
- `value` [String, Array<String>, nil] controlled pressed value (Array for `multiple`)
- `default_value` [String, Array<String>, nil] initially pressed value(s) (uncontrolled)
- `variant` [String, Symbol, nil] `"default"` or `"outline"`, applied to every item; not validated here, an unknown value raises ArgumentError when an item renders (via `Toggle.variants`)
- `size` [String, Symbol, nil] `"default"`, `"sm"` or `"lg"`, applied to every item; not validated here, an unknown value raises ArgumentError when an item renders (via `Toggle.variants`)
- `spacing` [Numeric] gap between items in spacing units; 0 joins the items
- `disabled` [Boolean] disables every item
- `roving_focus` [Boolean] arrow-key navigation with a single tab stop
- `orientation` [String, Symbol, nil] one of `ORIENTATIONS`; `data-orientation` is emitted on the root and the items only when `roving_focus` is true
- `dir` [String, Symbol, nil] one of `DIRECTIONS`; defaults to the surrounding direction provider
- `loop` [Boolean] whether arrow-key focus wraps around
- `as_child` [false, Symbol, String, Chadcn::Base] a tag (`:section`) or component instance to render instead of the `<div>`; false renders the default element
- `attrs` [Hash] HTML attributes for the root (`class:` merged last); a caller `style:` replaces the default `--gap` declaration

- DIRECTIONS: `ltr`, `rtl`
- ORIENTATIONS: `horizontal`, `vertical`
- TYPES: `single`, `multiple`

Parts (class, yielded-root helper, constructor):

- `ToggleGroup::Item` / `item`: `new(value:, variant: nil, size: nil, disabled: false, as_child: false, **attrs)` shadcn ToggleGroupItem: Radix Toggle inside a RovingFocusGroup item.

Stimulus: `chadcn--toggle-group`; values: `controlled`, `dir`, `initial`, `loop`, `orientation`, `roving-focus`, `type`; events (prefixed `chadcn--toggle-group:`): `value-change`

Example:

```ruby
render Chadcn::ToggleGroup.new(type: :multiple, variant: :outline, default_value: [ "bold" ]) do |group|
  group.item(value: "bold", aria: { label: "Bold" }) { "B" }
  group.item(value: "italic", aria: { label: "Italic" }) { "I" }
end
```

<a id="component-tooltip"></a>
## Tooltip

Root of the Tooltip family; must be rendered inside a `Tooltip::Provider`.

Constructor: `Chadcn::Tooltip.new(open: nil, default_open: false, delay_duration: nil, disable_hoverable_content: nil, id: nil)`

- `open` [Boolean, nil] controlled open state when not nil
- `default_open` [Boolean] initial open state when uncontrolled
- `delay_duration` [Integer, nil] ms before opening; falls back to the provider's
- `disable_hoverable_content` [Boolean, nil] close when the pointer leaves the trigger; falls back to the provider's
- `id` [String, nil] id of the content (what the trigger describes). Default `tooltip-N`, numbered per request with the engine, per render without it

Parts (class, yielded-root helper, constructor):

- `Tooltip::Content` / `content`: `new(side: "top", side_offset: 0, align: "center", align_offset: 0, avoid_collisions: true, collision_padding: 0, collision_boundary: nil, arrow_padding: 0, sticky: "partial", hide_when_detached: false, update_position_strategy: "optimized", force_mount: false, **attrs)` Tooltip bubble (with arrow).
- `Tooltip::Provider` / `provider`: `new(delay_duration: 0, skip_delay_duration: 300, disable_hoverable_content: false, id: nil)` Shares the delay options with the tooltips inside (renders no element).
- `Tooltip::Trigger` / `trigger`: `new(as_child: false, **attrs)` The element that shows the tooltip on hover/focus (renders a `button` and hosts the controller).

Stimulus: `chadcn--tooltip`; values: `content-id`, `controlled`, `delay-duration`, `disable-hoverable-content`, `open`, `provider-id`, `skip-delay-duration`; events (prefixed `chadcn--tooltip:`): `escape-key-down`, `open-change`, `pointer-down-outside`

Example:

```ruby
render Chadcn::Tooltip::Provider.new do
  render Chadcn::Tooltip.new do
    render Chadcn::Tooltip::Trigger.new { "Hover" }
    render Chadcn::Tooltip::Content.new { "Tip" }
  end
end
```

## Helpers

- `Chadcn::Icon.new(name, **attrs)`: Lucide icon, rendered like lucide-react 0.577.0 (see icons/catalog.rb).
